row.name: Solitude
row.detailed_description: Produced by Jerboa Interactive A downloadable game for Windows. Solitude was developed by four students over the course of 1.5 years as part of a school project at Humboldt-Gymnasium Potsdam. After crash-landing on a hostile alien world, you must explore, survive, and gather the parts needed to repair your damaged spaceship. Face dangerous environments, hostile machines, and mysterious structures as you fight to escape the planet. Guided (and occasionally insulted) by your ship’s sarcastic AI — “Try not to die again this time, would you?” — you’ll traverse the desert in search of whatever scrap, tech, or ancient alien junk might help get your ship flight-ready. Expect challenges, surprises, and the kind of tough love only a malfunctioning assistant can offer. 'Unbelievable what these four young developers have created in such a short time alongside their final two years of High school. Graphics, atmosphere, gameplay, and mechanics are all on point and provide a solid half hour of fun leading up to an epic finale. A debut title that will hopefully be followed by more projects.' - T. Bauer, Supervisor Seminarkurs GameDevelopment Humboldt-Gymnasium Potsdam

row.name: FlowCity Builder
row.detailed_description: FlowCity Builder is a cozy, relaxing, low-poly fantasy city builder. You start on an island with a few resources and build your first villager huts to welcome the opening tier of your civilization. As you meet their needs, you’ll unlock new blueprints and advance through four distinct tiers. Each tier introduces unique citizen types with their own demands and unlocks: Tier I: Villagers Tier II: Townfolk, Recruits, Acolytes Tier III: Merchants, Soldiers, Apprentices Tier IV: Nobles, Wizards, Priests Each citizen type has a unique set of needs to fulfill, and each provides new blueprints that, in turn, supply the resources and buildings they—or other citizens—require. The Game features an easy-to-use building system and a total of 58 unique buildings—some even include different visual variants for a more varied city look.

row.name: Satori | 悟り
row.detailed_description: Playing Satori | 悟り,  the player loses himself in a dream world to take an inner journey of meditation. The game is based on feelings of sadness and restlessness . These are conveyed through the detailed construction of an iconic world. The gameplay , presented in first-person perspective , features a series of puzzles based on sound effects, space, music, and video . The setting, music, and interaction is made to create a complete and coherent experience, in which the player must find his way around, seeking calm and clarity to find the right path. The story, lyrical and sometimes domestic, is told by pictures and impressions, as much through video, imagery and gameplay. At the same time, the player gets to create his own meditative experience, as the narrative is never intrusive and does not take over immersion. Satori | 悟り  can be played in many ways: the thoughtful and reflective player can shape his own interpretive path, investigating his truth and constructing his own meaning. At the same time, the player who cannot clearly find his path can rely on the clues provided by the creators to help him carry out his meditation path. ⠀ The duration of the game is variable, ranging from 30 to 60 min. To play this game it's recommended to use headphones or good quality speakers because many of the game's puzzles requires you to listen carefully to the music and game effects . ⠀ Are you ready to begin your journey within? ARTISTIC STATEMENT My name is Francesco. When I was about ten years old, my father was bedridden by a chronic illness. This wore down the marriage with my mother, who eventually filed for divorce. So, I remained motionless, watching my father's frustration and my mother's difficulties in rebuilding her life, locking myself in a solitude that I populated with art, literature, movies and especially video games. The exploration of these worlds and their meanings thus stimulated my imagination, which nevertheless always seemed to sketch blurred and imprecise worlds, less clear than a dream. So, I tried to sharpen those images through a path of meditation. I had my first meditation experiences several years ago. Approaching the method of transcendental meditation, I chose the word “satori” as my mantra. At first my choice was guided by a desire to cancel the distance between reality and the world revealed to me during meditative experiences. I used to interpret the idea of enlightenment in this way. But as my meditative path continued, I realised I should have faced my past directly. At this point, my personal life experience became a central point to my meditation, and the world that came out was increasingly dark, lonely and difficult. My name is Matteo. We met when we were about ten years old and shared difficulties and uncertainties, but above all we built together a world of fantasy and art, giving shape to our ghosts. I started studying the literature and the arts that allowed me to delve into the relationship between meaning and its representation. With this approach, I worked on Satori | 悟り , contributing to the development of imagery, graphic design, and the audio compartment. In this development, I tried to express my personal experience and the one shared with Francesco by integrating it with his.
row.short_description: SATORI | 悟り is a game that focuses on feelings of sadness and restlessness. In SATORI | 悟り the player immerses himself in a dream world to go on a inner journey of meditation. Are you ready to begin your journey within?

row.name: Cube Foundry
row.detailed_description: Dive into Cube Foundry , a captivating incremental game where every click counts! Starting from a single cube, expand your production to create an industrial empire. Unlock powerful generators, purchase strategic upgrades, and ascend through Mastery levels to dominate the cube universe. Simple to learn, incredibly satisfying to master! 🏗️ From Humble Clicks to Intergalactic Industry Your journey begins with a single, mysterious Central Cube . Each click generates valuable resources — the first sparks of your future empire. But this is just the beginning. Use your earnings to unlock a wide array of automated generators , each more advanced and efficient than the last. From the basic Mini Assembler to the awe-inspiring Dimensional Replicator , every machine helps you scale your cube production to astronomical levels. ⚙️ Optimize. Specialize. Evolve. In the Upgrades Panel , build a production strategy that matches your style: Increase your Click Power (CPC) Amplify specific generators or overall CPS Unlock special upgrades that merge active and passive income Progression unfolds through branching upgrade trees — choose your focus: clicks, early economy, or advanced automation. Every upgrade has prerequisites, encouraging long-term planning and specialization. 🔁 Prestige & Purpose: Reset to Rise Once your production reaches astronomical levels , it's time to reset — and evolve. Through the Prestige System , sacrifice short-term progress to gain Prestige Points (PP) and unlock permanent upgrades : Boost CPC and CPS multipliers Start future runs with pre-built advantages Climb faster, stronger, and smarter with every loop 🧠 Master the Foundry The deeper your cube journey, the more you unlock the Mastery System — a powerful metagame with two layers: 🎓 Mastery Levels grant permanent passive bonuses and Mastery Points (MP) 🔧 Mastery Attributes (Power, Efficiency, Economy, Prestige, Fortune) let you shape your factory’s strengths, with scaling costs that reward specialization and smart allocation. 🏆 Achievements & Secrets Await Track your milestones — or stumble upon hidden ones. Whether it's your total clicks, mastery levels, or how many times you've prestiged, Achievements offer permanent rewards and secret bonuses for the most dedicated players.
row.short_description: Classic Incremental Gameplay: Easy to start, with a depth that will keep you hooked as you optimize your strategy. Satisfying Progression: Feel the power grow as your production numbers explode. Mastery System: Long-term rewards for your dedication and total production.

row.name: Together in Forgotten Lands: Chapter One
row.detailed_description: In a world forgotten by time, an ancient cave lies hidden atop a mystical mountain, waiting to be explored. Two adventurers, bound by destiny, embark on a journey into its depths, uncovering secrets lost to history. Inside, they encounter bizarre plants, mysterious creatures, and arcane forces that challenge both their wits and teamwork. The deeper they venture, the more they realize that the cave is not just a place—it’s a living entity, shifting and transforming as if aware of their presence. What secrets does it hold? What trials must they overcome? Only through trust and collaboration can they hope to unravel the cave’s mysteries and make it out alive. Together in Forgotten Lands is a co-op puzzle adventure where two players must navigate through four distinct biomes, each offering unique challenges and enigmas. Light-based puzzles, intricate labyrinths, platforming trials, and musical riddles await those who dare to enter. Every puzzle requires teamwork, every obstacle demands coordination, and every step forward unearths another piece of a forgotten past. Do you have what it takes to escape the cave’s grasp? Feature List Two-Player Co-op: Designed exclusively for two players. Work together to solve mind-bending puzzles and navigate a dynamic, ever-changing cave. Diverse Biomes: Explore four breathtaking biomes, each with its own distinct atmosphere, mechanics, and creatures. Engaging Puzzles: A wide variety of challenges including light manipulation, spatial puzzles, rhythm-based mechanics, and platforming segments. A Living World: The cave reacts to your presence, shifting, changing, and unveiling new paths as you progress. A Mysterious Story: Unravel the history of a forgotten world through cryptic messages, environmental storytelling, and the enigmatic forces that dwell within. MECHANICS Explore Venture through an ancient cave filled with breathtaking landscapes, enigmatic ruins, and hidden paths. Each step forward reveals a new layer of mystery waiting to be uncovered. Cooperate Every puzzle is built for two. Communicate, strategize, and synchronize your actions to navigate obstacles that can only be overcome together. Solve Together From intricate musical riddles to complex light-reflection challenges, solving puzzles requires logical thinking, creativity, and teamwork. Every solution brings you one step closer to the truth. Escape the Cave The deeper you go, the more the cave reveals its true nature. Can you outsmart its ever-changing and escape its ancient grip before it’s too late? Note: This game is not a sequel to Together in Between and is designed exclusively for two players.
row.short_description: Two souls, one destiny. Embark on a co-op adventure through a forgotten land, where teamwork and wit are the only way to navigate the wonders and dangers of a magical cave.

row.name: Appointment Mentor VR

From scheduling an appointment by phone to checking in with the receptionist, speaking with a nurse, and talking with the doctor, users can explore and practice each step at their own pace. Whether preparing for a first appointment or reducing anxiety through repetition, Appointment Mentor VR offers a supportive space to build real-world readiness—free to everyone!   This project is supported by the Organization for Autism Research (OAR), and by the Health Resources and Services Administration (HRSA) of the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) under the Autism Intervention Research Network on Physical Health (AIR‐P) grant, UT2MC39440. row.short_description: Super-B is a free-to-play multiplayer game with AAA 3D graphics, where players become toy characters in a brick-built world. It features 12+ game modes at launch, offering fast-paced action and social interaction.

row.name: Underground: Chapter 1
row.detailed_description: Environmental Puzzles Use notes, clues, and observations to solve puzzles. Sometimes the answer is right in front of you — and sometimes it’s hidden in the shadows. About the Game Underground is a first-person horror adventure where you wake up lost, with no memory of how you got here — and no idea where 'home' is. As you explore a strange and seemingly abandoned subway system, you begin to uncover notes, clues, and puzzles that guide you from station to station. But you're not alone down there. Survive encounters with terrifying entities that stalk the tunnels. Make decisions that affect your survival, and solve increasingly complex puzzles that block your escape. Each station presents a unique challenge — from tracking down the right medication for a patient under time pressure, to escaping a deadly chase after choosing the wrong item. Key Features: A story-driven single-player horror experience Multiple underground stations , each with its own set of puzzles, atmosphere, and secrets Checkpoints between stations so progress isn’t lost A mix of stealth, puzzle-solving, and decision-based gameplay Dynamic horror elements that react to your choices Minimal UI for full immersion
row.short_description: Underground is a first-person horror-puzzle game where you explore a mysterious subway system, solve deadly puzzles, and escape the creatures lurking in the dark. Will the train take you home—or deeper into the nightmare?

row.name: The Wind and the Wisp
row.detailed_description: The Wind and The Wisp is an adventure game about two best friends. One who has passed away and awoken as a ghost in a mysterious broken garden. And one who is still alive and misses their friend dearly.  Through the combination of traditional input methods and the power of your breath, control both characters and join them on their journey through grief as they bridge the divide and bring life and structure back to the broken garden together. The Wind and the Wisp is a story about love and loss, and seeks to build a sense of connection in the wake of loneliness. Features A lovable little ghost character, the Wisp!  Blow into the microphone to trigger Wind and interact with the world and the Wisp! Solve puzzles by blowing into the microphone and activating unique flower mechanics. A beautiful world to explore with hidden interactions!
row.short_description: A 3D adventure game about blowing into the microphone. Join the Wind, a non-corporeal petal breeze, and the Wisp, a little white ghost with a red ribbon, on their journey to repair a mysterious broken garden.

row.name: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude
row.detailed_description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude contains the first two dungeons and boss fights of the game. All progress carries over to the main game. Beyond the jagged seas lies the the land of Dragaea, you arrived on it's shores called by a mysterious force in a dream to discover it's secrets and become a legend in your own right. Legends of Dragaea is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler, where you form parties of heroes and plumb mysterious dungeons in search of glory, wealth, and loot. Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is inspired by classic JRPGs distilling down the essence to it's roots as an idle dungeon crawler. Discover unique locations, visit the Adventurer's Guild and tear quests from the quest board advancing through the tiered ranking system reaping greater rewards. Encounter dangerous enemies that will test your might, and confront calamitous bosses. As your heroes fell enemies, your knowledge of monsters grow filling the Beastiary with valuable knowledge making all your heroes more effective in combat! Fight in massive 9-man boss raids utilizing your powerful roster of heroes for glory and loot! Build your own guild from the ground up, unlock guild upgrades, customize your heroes and guild banner from a wide variety of emblems or your own custom images. Your success as a guild translates into greater services as you build out the town unlocking more options for your guild like expeditions and a large roster, better resources to exploit, growing from a small village to a bustling city. Choose from 22 combat and utility skills for a robust free-form and classless skill system including melee, ranged, and magic characters allowing you to specialize your heroes any way you wish. Augment your team with over 25+ abilities like Bonk, Fissure, and Life Steal, using any 5 abilities in any combination you choose. As you explore Dragaea you will be able to recruit new party members to aid you in your journey forming multiple teams of 3 to explore dungeons and tackle challenges becoming the finest adventuring guild in all the land. You can even unlock expeditions that allow your parties to adventure while the game is off! The land of Dragaea is a place filled mystery, intrigue, and precious treasure. Collect and upgrade over 200+ pieces of weapons, armor, accessories, items, and other consumables to augment your party's prowess. No two pieces of equipment are the same with different rarities and stats affecting the possibilities. Found a favorite axe or staff? Upgrade it to it's max potential and give your adventurers the finest tools to do the job. A full featured inventory system and shop system lets you manage your collections effortlessly.
row.short_description: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler with 6 unique races, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique dungeons, a classless skill system, and an extensive guild management system to master as you uncover the world of Dragaea!

row.name: SolCycle
row.detailed_description: Explore the world of SolCycle as renowned archaeologist and professor PRIV-8! After being laid off due to budget cuts, you decide to travel in search of a mysterious new artifact but find yourself trapped in a time-loop instead! Now you must learn to navigate the locals’ bartering culture using trade-based mechanics whilst still keeping your goal in mind. Who knows what that artifact could do for you when you finally get it…it’ll just have to be worth the trouble! In this solarpunk post-human world, plant-powered robots now worship the soil, creating civilization and structure that values trade above monetization! Meet inhabitants of this community, such as a priestess of the religious order, a shady merchant, and a well-revered mailman. Learn to navigate each segfault, the phenomenon known to reset your time-loop, and come back stronger and more knowledgeable each time! Features: Three animal-themed characters to interact and trade with. Cast of small fruit-themed beings called roros to play with. Unique location themes with original music!
row.short_description: Enter the 3D sci-fi world of SolCycle! Play as a robot cat archaeologist, explore a post-human community rebuilt by plant-fueled robots, and barter with the locals in card-based gameplay! Learn to navigate the citizens’ requests while under the spell of a time-loop. Don’t forget to watch the clock!

row.short_description: Where's that Clown is a frantic top down arcade game where you must keep impatient kids entertained throughout chaotic birthday party venues. Dash around, dodging toddlers and parents as you try to get the highest score!

row.name: Doorway 2

Jump, slide, and crawl through chaotic, ever-changing obstacle rooms in a surreal world. Run solo or compete with others in multiplayer—every second counts. Miss a jump? No sweat. You’ll respawn at the start of the last room you entered. No full resets, just fast retries that keep you in the flow. With unique boss arenas, time-based challenges, and movement-focused design, Doorway 2 is all about pushing your limits without ever hitting pause. row.name: Zoomers Versus Boomers

The Zoomers outnumber the Boomers three to one, but each Zoomer that gets defeated becomes a Boomer. The only way for Zoomers win is to stay alive long enough for the clock to hit zero. Boomers, on the other hand, can win by defeating every Zoomer. The Zoomers Zoomers have a choice between three weapons. Prefer the long range? Use the slow firing but heavy hitting tablet. More of a medium range player? The spray of phones has you covered. Prefer to blast the Boomers yourself, close and personal? The fan of phones fits your style perfectly. The Boomers Boomers one goal is to explode a Zoomer. To do that, they've got the ability to sprint and climb walls at frightening speeds. They can also charge their explosion, giving them greater range and damage the longer they hold onto it for. Though if they charge it for too long, they'll explode! Two unique maps Zoomers versus Boomers features two maps, a sprawling city with tall buildings and a metropolis full of speeding buses. Players can vote on the map they want to play on every few rounds.
row.short_description: Ever wanted to explode your friends as a wheel chair bound old man? Now you can! In Zoomers Versus Boomers, the Zoomers try to avoid getting blown up for as long as possible. Hurl phones at your friends! Run as they converge on your position in a vast tidal wave of old men! Try not to explode!

row.name: Obgoose
row.detailed_description: Do you despise playing scrabble with others? The feeling that everyone knows more words than you? Well, now this time is over. Obgoose is a singleplayer non-competitive scrabble-like game where no one will ever know when you are obtuse. 1. Why am I a goose? Honk! Move by using the arrow keys. 2. My goal? Join letter tiles and form words. 3. What about the points? You score a point, if you are using all letters and build a connected crossword of valid words. 4. The letter tile is in an unreachable position? Push it out of the screen. It will reappear. 5. I got too many bad letters? Push one letter tile into the well. It will punish you by giving two letter tiles back.
row.short_description: Tired of feeling obtuse in Scrabble? Try Obgoose, a solo, non-competitive word game where you can play at your own pace.

row.name: Cauldron Chaos
row.detailed_description: Your master has left you in charge of his apothecary for two full weeks. Sounds easy enough... until the shop fills with demanding magical customers, your potion recipes pile up, and chaos starts bubbling over. Cauldron Chaos is a top-down, 2.5D potion-making game where you brew, bottle, and sell potions as fast and accurately as possible — all before the day ends. 🧪 What You’ll Do: Follow a queue of potion recipes delivered to you in a fixed order. Pick up ingredients, add them to the cauldron, stir when required, and bottle the final brew. Deliver potions to whichever customer is asking for them — there's no strict order, and no individual timers. Work against the day’s overall time limit to complete as many correct potions as you can before closing. ✨ Core Features: Hands-On Potion Crafting : Simple, satisfying actions like grabbing ingredients, stirring, and bottling bring each potion to life. Flexible Customer Queue : Serve potions based on need — if someone wants the finished brew, they’ll take it, regardless of line order. Time-Based Pressure : You’re racing the clock, not the customers. Efficient brewing and multitasking are key. Chaotic Daily Events : Every other in-game day throws a magical wrench into your routine — reversed controls, ingredient mix-ups, and more. Two-Week Challenge : Survive 14 increasingly wild days and prove you’re ready to run the apothecary for good. Cozy Yet Chaotic Vibes : Enjoy a whimsical magical shop aesthetic, filled with colorful potions, silly mishaps, and charming characters. Can you master the art of potion-making under pressure and keep the shop afloat until your master returns?
row.short_description: Your master’s gone. You’re in charge. What could go wrong? Brew potions, bottle them up, and desperately try to keep magical customers happy while chaos rains down every other day. Stir fast. Don’t explode. You’ve got 14 days to not burn the place down.

row.name: The HELL Prologue
row.detailed_description: As Hell’s Governor, your task isn’t just building a city —it’s transforming chaos into order in a realm ruled by sin. Here, every decision and every soul counts. In this city builder, you’ll craft an infernal hell city from the remnants of despair, balancing limited resources while harnessing the power of lost souls. Navigate the dark challenges inspired by the seven deadly sins and confront colossal titans that guard the underworld’s secrets. Each mission dives deep into lore and tests your strategic skills, as every failure paves the way for your resurgence. Every cycle through the underworld teaches you something new: past mistakes become future strengths, and each new attempt brings you closer to building a legacy that defies eternal damnation. Focusing on immersive storytelling and dynamic gameplay, The HELL challenges you to reshape a realm where every structure tells a story of sin, suffering, and ultimate redemption. Your dominion spans centuries. Souls arrive from humanity’s most catastrophic moments—from the chilling Fimbulwinter of ancient Nordic legends to the devastating Great Kanto Earthquake of Japan, and disasters ranging from the early 600-700 AD to the 18th century. In this launch, experience seven immersive missions that shape the very fabric of your underworld: Dancing Plates of Kanto, Japan ( 1923 ) [Earthquake] Broken Vein of Krakatoa, Indonesia ( 1883 ) [Volcano Eruption] Witching Hour of Aztec, South America ( 1540 ) [Plague] Stolen Sun of Northern Scandinavia ( 536 ) [Severe Cold] Cracked Lips of Ancient Egypt ( 2200bc ) [Drought] Wet Dream of Ancient Mesopotamia ( 3500bc ) [Flood] Topsy Turvy of __________________ [Time] Each mission is defined by its unique setting and features a formidable Titan and a narrative intricately tied to one of the seven deadly sins . Every map offers a distinct experience and challenge, ensuring no two missions are alike.   Unlike traditional city builders focused solely on population growth , The HELL challenges you to process these souls into Sinners—the essential workforce that fuels your hell city. As souls burst into your environment through the gaping maw of a Titan, they scatter and converge at a monumental structure known as The Purgatoria. Here, the raw, wandering spirits are queued for transformation, eventually forming the backbone of your infernal labor force. And when disaster strikes, feel the earthquake as the screen shakes, immersing you in the raw power of the underworld. Before transformation, all souls are held in a designated area known as The Wait. This space is subdivided into three distinct zones—The Wait: Fire, The Wait: Ice, and the Blood Hall—each influencing the eventual form of the souls as they are processed. Here, every soul patiently awaits its fate, adding depth and strategy to your transformation process. Resource management is key to building a thriving infernal hell city. As Hell’s Governor, you will strategically harness and utilize four primary resources—Blood, Waste, Cries, and Fears—to keep your city functioning and expand your dark domain. Cries: Used to nurture the Dreadful Tree, which unlocks new technologies and strategic options to enhance your city’s capabilities. Imagine your ordinary souls becoming swift, relentless protectors of your realm, standing as a bulwark against the encroaching darkness. By continually evolving and adapting your defensive strategy, you ensure that your city remains a bastion of order and strength amidst the eternal chaos of Hell. To counter internal chaos, you can transform idle Sinners into specialized units: Sentries : Act as guardians in your buildings to deter resource-stealing Shallow. Discover extraterrestrial secrets and how to stop the alien invasion. Environmental Puzzles : Test your wit with puzzles and enigmas. Use objects in creative and unexpected ways and overcome the environmental challenges you'll encounter along your path. Exploration : From the uncontrolled traffic of Italian streets to alien spaceship technology, navigating interstellar bureaucratic corridors, offices, and galactic call centers. Inventory System : Collect items, use them at the right time and place, or give them to someone who knows best how to use them to progress in the adventure. Comic and Original Story : Immerse yourself in a plot that unfolds through cutscenes, quotes, memorable characters, and a continuous series of increasingly absurd situations caused by the encounter (or clash) between Italian and alien culture. Duration : A short, concentrated adventure (like tomato sauce), lasting about 1 hour, ideal for a pasta-and-pixel weekend or a fun and fulfilling game session.
row.short_description: 'When aliens order pasta, only one guy can deliver justice!' You're a food delivery guy in this short, comical graphic adventure, determined to stop the monopoly on Italian cousine imposed by an alien invasion.

row.name: Mega Dimension Ripper 9000
row.detailed_description: Twin-stick shooter roguelite with environment-merging levels! Play with 1-4 players in this wacky interdimensional gauntlet! Features 1–4 Player Co-op Roguelite (Play locally or online with Steam Remote Play Together) Single Player: Use Mouse & Keyboard or Controller Co-op: Controllers Required Multiple Difficulty Options (Try Your Best at 'Mega') Endless Waves of Diverse Enemy Types Discover Powerful Upgrade Combinations Seamlessly Merge Into New Environments Mid-Level Setting In this 1-4 player, couch co-op, roguelite party game, you play as combatants being teleported against their will into a life-threatening arena by the scary, yet charismatic, 'General'. With his prototyped teleportation technology malfunctioning, he sends wacky and unlikely environments from across the multiverse to merge onto the arena as the levels progress.  ​ Gameplay Experience fast progression, permanent powerups, and procedurally generated levels commonly found in the roguelike genre. Rather than exploring larger areas in longer levels, you must instead survive with your team in a small top-down arena. This arena will shift and glitch between environments for two minutes while waves of enemies are sent by the 'General' to test you. It’s life or death, and freedom is waiting for you at the end! How to Use Controllers Other Than Xbox Connect your desired controllers to the device Find Mega Dimension Ripper 9000 in your Steam library Click on the 'Manage' button on the right side of your screen Select 'Properties' Select the 'Controller' tab on the new window Click the dropdown on the right side of the new window Select 'Enable Steam Input' or 'Use Default Settings' You can now close out of that window and play the game with various controller type * Some controllers may need to be plugged into the system How to Use Steam Remote Play Together From the Friends tab When in game, press Shift + Tab to open steam overlay Open the 'Friends' tab at the bottom of the screen Right click on friend you want to invite Select 'Remote Play Together' From the Remote Play Together tab When in game, press Shift + Tab to open steam overlay Open the 'Remote Play Together' tab at the bottom of the screen Select Invite a Friend Select up to 3 friends you would like to invite Select 'Confirm'
row.short_description: Twin-stick shooter roguelite with environment-merging levels! With 1-4 players, survive for two minutes in each level while waves of relentless enemies are sent to attack you! Combine powerful upgrades and earn your freedom in this wacky interdimensional gauntlet!

row.name: Skull Hotel
row.detailed_description: Immersive Horror Experience Experience realistic graphics and a chilling horror soundscape that intensifies as you progress. Every detail is designed to keep you on edge. Unpredictable Danger With a variety of original horror mechanics and dozens of hiding spots, you never know where the next threat will come from. Each playthrough is unique, making every cleaning shift a new experience. Easy to Learn, Hard to Master Skull Hotel is easy to pick up and play and can be finished in under 10 minutes, but its psychological horror and unpredictable gameplay make it truly difficult to complete. Expect to die multiple times before finishing the game. Leave Your Mark Survive your shift and sign the guest book at the reception to prove you made it. Will your name be remembered, or will you become just another lost guest?
row.short_description: Skull Hotel is a horror game where you clean hotel rooms while creatures hide, waiting to kill you.
row.reviews: 8.1/10 – FWA Awards 8.4/10 – CSS Design Awards 7.5/10 – Awwwards
row.notes: This horror game contains intense jump scares, gore, blood, dead animals, corpses, and disturbing imagery. Not suitable for children or sensitive players.

row.name: Cave of Gurg
row.detailed_description: 'Dark. Silent. Waiting.' This game is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs entirely on the command line. The player takes on the role of a hunter, exploring a mysterious cave and attempting to hunt down a terrifying man-eating creature known as the 'Gurg.' In this game, understanding your surroundings through messages that appear after each action is the key to survival and victory. The Cave: The cave consists of several rooms, each assigned a unique number. While the overall structure of the cave is fixed, the room numbers are randomly assigned in each playthrough. In addition to the 'Gurg,' two 'giant bats' lurk somewhere in the cave. Yes, two of them. The Hunter: Armed only with a bow and three arrows, the hunter bravely challenges the Gurg. Victory is achieved by striking the Gurg with an arrow. However, if the hunter is eaten by the Gurg, falls into a pit, or runs out of arrows, the game is over. Play Time: Each play session takes approximately 1 to 10 minutes. Notes: The introductory game guide can be skipped. For details, please check the “option” menu in-game. The application relies on the user's command line environment. There is no audio output.
row.short_description: 'Dark. Silent. Waiting.' This is a text-based, turn-based strategy mini-game that runs on the command line. You play as a hunter exploring a mysterious cave in pursuit of the terrifying, man-eating creature known as the 'Gurg.'

row.name: 帝王拆迁办
row.detailed_description: 创作背景： 《帝王拆迁办》是一款基于原作游戏《代号鸢》创作的邈广CP向剧情解谜类RPG同人游戏。 故事内容： 东海再往东，会有鲛人吗？鱼尾很好吃的。哭出来的珍珠磨成粉，肯定很显白吧。年少时你们挤在河边闲谈，纵是乱世，亲信好友都在身边，也能偷得几分清闲。 后来你成为了天命所归，可身边再也不见旧日并肩而立的身影。东海不见鲛人，只见列列成行的商船和战船。 史书上说，文汉天女，承载天命，开创一代盛世。 可跳出命数与身份的框架，或许留在史书上的结局并不是属于你真正的结局。 前脚刚下了这辈子的班，后脚就在地府领到了新任务......还好还好， 这次不打仗不政变，只在地府观光， 好消息是，老朋友还在等你，坏消息是……嗯，他可能记得比你还清楚。 是误会、执念，还是……一点点没说出口的小心思？谁知道呢，反正你们俩现在都走不掉了。 谋士等太久都等过期了，不上钩怎么办？拿装过珍珠粉的碗来捞一下！ 声明： 本作为游戏爱好者基于对角色的喜爱和欣赏制作的免费同人游戏，仅供交流分享，非盈利性项目。同时不涉及任何商业用途与盈利行为。 部分场景模型素材来自互联网公开分享。如无意间侵犯到您的权益，请及时与我们联系，我们将在第一时间修改，并在此向您致以诚挚的歉意。 本作为同人创作，不代表任何立场或观点，亦无意影响原作设定及剧情或角色解读。 制作人员： 玩法：丸山奇迹 & 冲浪吸猫 程序：冲浪吸猫 剧本：丸山奇迹 角色模型：冲浪吸猫 模型动画：冲浪吸猫 角色立绘：冲浪吸猫 游戏CG：冲浪吸猫 游戏图标：丸山奇迹 主界面：丸山奇迹 Steam成就：丸山奇迹 魂魂立绘：丸山奇迹 游戏测试（按完成顺序排名）：冲浪吸猫、世界腰椎保护协会 & 恐怖鼠、丸山奇迹、橙子、慕容雪珂、Bunnye叶、牧可
row.short_description: 变成魂魂之后，连天命之外的重逢都是轻飘飘的。如果真心被妙语连珠粉饰，那就不要去听，不要开口。嘘——看到了吗？他走马灯投下来的光影。

row.name: Aesop Rock's Black Hole Superette Experience
row.detailed_description: Aesop Rock's Black Hole Superette Experience is a surreal, first-person exploration game set in a fictional convenience store brimming with absurdity, hidden meanings, and sonic treasures. As you wander the aisles in search of audio fragments, you’ll unlock cryptic words of wisdom from Aesop Rock himself. Sample your way through the entire Black Hole Superette album, uncover exclusive content, and dig into a universe packed with deep cuts, easter eggs, and offbeat lore only the most dedicated heads will decode. Welcome to the weirdest corner store you’ve never escaped!
row.short_description: A surreal first-person exploration game where you roam a fictional convenience store, collect hidden audio fragments, and unlock cryptic wisdom. Sample the full Black Hole Superette album, discover hidden easter eggs, and dive into a twisted soundscape of interactive hip-hop absurdity.

row.name: Pippa and Your Phantasmal Problem
row.detailed_description: ★ Story Ms Ester's beautiful and neat house has been mysteriously wrecked in the past few weeks and nobody knows why. Patches of dirt on the carpet, things gone missing, and all sorts of mess keeps happening around the house. The police was called to investigate, a priest was invited to bless the house, and a group of ghostbusters was hired (they were so expensive!) and none of them found anything. How useless! If this problem isn't solved by the time Ms Ester returns from her short trip, she'll kick you out. You have to find someone who can help: anyone will do, even this unreliable looking, self-proclaimed witch you just randomly met. ' Pippa is going to save the day! Hehehe~ ' ★ Features Around 15,000 words in total. 3 endings: 1 bad ending and 2 good endings. Choose what to feed Pippa: the food chosen affects Pippa's magical energy, which will influence the story. Cute character art and cute soundtracks. Cute dogs! ★ Credits story, art, programming:  Konayachi soundtrack composer:  Dalton Attig (special thanks to Bristol!) proofreaders:  S.B.Hunter, ebi-hime, Wan-chan misc. programming help:  an anonymous family member sfx:  freesfx, pixabay background art references:  pxhere, minikle tools:  ActionEditor3, guiManipulate other software:  Krita, VSCodium engine:  Ren'Py This VN is made in a month for Spooktober Visual Novel Jam 2024!
row.short_description: Find out who's been messing up your home with this troublesome witch!

row.name: Revenant: Through The Veil
row.detailed_description: Hossam Sharawi An archaeologist devastated by the loss of his lover, embarks on a daring quest into forbidden pyramids and ancient temples of Egypt. Armed with the Book of the Dead, he must summon powerful Egyptian gods and face them to navigate the risky journey through the afterlife. To bring back his lost lover, he needs to outwit and overcome these gods, each guarding a different tomb. Some gods are obstacles, seeking to hinder his progress, while others offer aid. Hossam’s ultimate goal is to reach the Field of Reeds, retrieve his lost love, and escape back to the land of the living. EGYPTIAN MYTHOLOGY Inspired by Ancient Egypt’s Book of the Dead, immerse yourself and embark on a journey through the afterlife and encounter the many gods and goddesses in Egyptian mythology. PUZZLES Immerse yourself and explore the atmospheric environments in Revenant. Each level consists of puzzles that need to be completed to further progress through the afterlife. SOULS-LIKE COMBAT Lock onto enemies, dodge their attacks, and utilize the abilities granted to you by the gods to fight your way through the servants of the dead in the afterlife.
row.short_description: When love defies death, the gods take notice. Armed with the Book of the Dead, archaeologist Hossam Sharawi must face ancient gods, survive cursed tombs, and journey through the Egyptian afterlife to bring back the one he lost.

row.name: Narb Fortunii
row.detailed_description: Narb Fortunii is a short, story driven adventure filled with fun dialogue and music. Move through the world and take in the different environments, characters, and sounds as the mystery of why you fell into this world unravels. This linear adventure is not just one dimensional. Use the pause menu for help to continue to a 3D platforming challenge will bring you to the end, or restart you if the menu's music wasn't fully enjoyed. Take off your specs and lock yourself into place, mid-air, to complete the final jumps that will bring you to the end.
row.short_description: Narb Fortunii is a short, story driven adventure. Move through the environment and read the characters dialogue while you enjoy the music. Complete a platforming challenge to reach the final conversation of this whimsical adventure.

row.name: Hook, Line, and Axe
row.detailed_description: Hook, Line, and Axe is a third person hack-and-slash parkour set in a dystopian America. In this fictional world, nothing is truly as it seems, and a tyrannical government has corrupted far more than anyone suspected. It’s up to you, an Insurrectionist and conspiracy theorist, to put a stop to them once and for all. With nothing more than a battle axe, take the fight to the military at Area 51. Talk about bringing an axe to a gunfight! Upon discovering a high-tech grapple hook inside, you must swing around to traverse this dangerous terrain, find collectibles, unleash a full arsenal of combat abilities at your disposal, and unlock secrets on the most dangerous and unpredictable mission the world has ever seen in  Hook, Line, and Axe . Hook, Line, and Axe currently is a standalone game that serves as a ' Part One ' to the story. There WILL be a Part Two, Sequel, or DLC should the game receive adequate funding or a significant amount of interest. Until then, our small group of developers hopes you enjoy the game in its current capacity! Warning : Game contains some stylized violence and may contain content that is too mature for some users.
row.short_description: Swing into action in this third-person hack-and-slash parkour set in a sci-fi dystopian America. Strike down corruption with your trusty battle axe. Grapple onto enemies and the environment alike. Chain abilities for the ultimate combo of destruction in Hook, Line, and Axe.
row.notes: Mild to moderate stylized fictional violence including blood spray, ragdoll deaths, and undetailed decapitation.

row.short_description: Click apples, trade up, and grow your orchard! Collect apples by tapping, then exchange or trade with other players to unlock higher-tier apples. Simple, addictive, and full of juicy rewards!

row.name: Nuclear Meltdown
row.detailed_description: Nuclear Meltdown is a tense, fast-paced cooperative game where a group of ordinary people are thrust into an extraordinary crisis: a nuclear power plant emergency. Trapped inside the control center, players must respond to an escalating catastrophe—without any technical expertise. You play as a visiting delegation touring the facility when, without warning, disaster strikes. A sudden explosion knocks out all communication lines and incapacitates the technical staff. As the security doors seal shut, you're left alone in front of a maze of blinking lights, switches, and warning sirens—none of which you understand. Your only link to the outside world is an outdated data terminal capable of receiving brief text instructions and sending simple YES or NO replies. Guided by minimal communication and your own instincts, you must work together under pressure, interpret cryptic console interfaces, and try to prevent a full-scale nuclear meltdown. Finanziato dall’Unione europea – Next Generation EU
row.short_description: Nuclear meltdown is a collective video game in which a group of players find themselves having to face an emergency in a nuclear power plant despite not having the technical skills.

row.name: VrmFrontView
row.detailed_description: VRMFrontView allows you to record gameplay using your own avatar. With LIV MR mode, you can overlay your VRM Avatar onto your games and simultaneously use a separate camera for a facecam. Features Supports VRM0, VRM1(experimental), vfsavatar (experimental) SteamVR Tracker Support SteamVR Avatar Mirror Overlay VMC(Virtual Motion Capture) Protocol Receiving and Transmitting Custom Background (supported files: png, jpg, mp4) Hotkey mapping for Blendshapes and Camera control VR Chat OSC Sending (DanceDash Bodylink Compatible) MMD playback And More!
row.short_description: VrmFrontView: Free app for content creators/VTubers to record or stream VR gameplay with personalized VRM avatars overlaid. Supports mixed reality (e.g., LIV), VMC protocol for avatar animation, custom backgrounds, and hotkey control.

row.name: Black Dungeon: Draw A Card
row.detailed_description: Black Dungeon: Draw A Card is a pixel-style action game combining rogue-like dungeon exploration, card drawing, and real-time combat. You play as a lowly scroll-binder, accidentally dragged into the Devourer Dungeon. By drawing and casting powerful skill cards, you’ll battle fierce enemies, strengthen your deck, and eventually confront the final boss. Each card is a tactical decision—Fireball, Toxic Mist, Meteoric, even hidden cards. You’ll need to master combos, invincibility rolls, shields, and rage boosts to survive intense battles across maze-like rooms. The game supports mouse and keyboard controls. Cards are played via drag-and-drop, blending strategy with smooth, responsive action. Every interaction features dynamic effects. With camera shakes triggered by attacks, hits, and boss skills, each strike feels impactful. Randomly generated dungeon layouts, enemy groups, and treasure rewards ensure high replay-ability. As you progress, enemies grow stronger, and the stakes rise with every level—beating it once is just the beginning. Clear the dungeon three times in a row, and you might even unlock secret content…？ With crisp UI, juicy animations, and immersive BGM sets for every stage—from entering the dungeon to defeating the boss—this visually rich, mechanically polished game is 100% free!
row.short_description: Once a lowly servant of the Arcane Illustration Society, you triggered a portal while reading the forbidden Codex Obscura and were cast into the Devourer Dungeon. Branded by its core, you gained scrollbinding powers. Explore, collect lost cards, and seal the Demon Devourer: Taotie.

row.name: Shards of the Banished
row.detailed_description: Overview: Shards of the Banished is a soulslike action RPG set in a post-apocalyptic dark fantasy world. You play as a lone warrior cast into a land consumed by glimmering darkness and the ashes of what was once a prosperous realm. Survive brutal encounters, explore ruined landscapes, and harness the mysterious power of crystals to uncover the truth behind your banishment. Key Features: Deep Combat System : Master a stamina-based melee combat system with dodge rolls, parries, and powerful finishers. Character Progression : Unlock new abilities through a detailed skill tree tailored to your combat style. Talismans : Collect and equip a variety of talismans that grant passive bonuses, stat boosts, and special effects. Boss Fights : Face off against 3 deadly bosses, each with unique mechanics and challenges. World Design : Navigate interconnected areas filled with secrets, traps, shortcuts, and hidden lore. Replayability : Multiple builds and playstyles encourage experimentation and repeated playthroughs. Atmospheric World : Experience a haunting soundtrack and environmental storytelling that deepen the immersion.
row.short_description: Shards of the Banished is a dark fantasy action-RPG set in a cursed medieval world. A fallen king, a cursed queen, and a power-hungry usurper have plunged the land into ruin. As the exiled heir, you must rise, face powerful foes, and reclaim what is rightfully yours.
row.notes: The game contains frequent depictions of blood and gore, themes of suicide, and frightening imagery involving monsters. Viewer discretion is advised.

row.name: 电子厂之城
row.detailed_description: ​​Game genre: Visual novel. ​​Clear time​: Approximately 55 minutes. The story is fictional. Synopsis   They say stories are fundamental tools for understanding the world. Yet crafting a good story demands both skill and resources. Does this inevitably mean some people possess an inherent advantage—or disadvantage—in telling their tale?   In the early 2020s, as the great tide of the era receded, grains of sand were settling into position. Yet young hearts forever yearn to charge forward—even when the enemy remains unseen, or when only imagined foes can be found.
row.short_description: A story of seven young workers in an electronics factory in the early 2020s.

row.name: Craball
row.detailed_description: P lay as a crab trying to keep a ball in the air. Move side to side, bop the ball up, and scoop up gold as they rain down upon you! The longer you keep the bounce going, the more treasure you earn. Relaxing, meditative, replayable, and yet surprisingly difficult. Play alone or with a friend in Coop and competitive mode. 🎮 How to Play Move left and right with the joystick Keep the ball bouncing Collect coins for extra points Miss a bounce? It’s game over! ✨ Features 🦀 Simple joystick controls: just move left or right 🏐 Ball physics: keep it bouncing as long as you can 💰 Coin collection and score chasing 🔁 Easy to pick up and play 🎯 For Players Who: Like casual reflex games Difficult games
row.short_description: Bop the ball. Collect coins. Don’t let it touch the ground! Easy to play. Hard to play well. (This game is deceptively difficult. You've been warned.)

row.name: Stanley Says
row.detailed_description: In 2001, you were taken. And somehow, you survived. Over two decades later, you return to the place that should have stayed buried: Stanley’s World. Once a cheerful drop-off nursery for children—where parents left their kids while they ran errands or went to work—it was abruptly shut down in 2001, just days after a string of mysterious disappearances... and the world changed forever. Now it’s quiet. Empty. Almost. 🕹️ Stanley Says is a first-person puzzle horror game set in the decaying remains of a once-trusted childcare center. Piece together the twisted history of Harvey Lamon , the man behind the madness, and Stanley , the smiling mascot who never really left. 💀 Features: Explore eerie environments dripping with corrupted childhood nostalgia Solve dark puzzles to unlock doors, secrets, and memories long forgotten Follow Stanley’s rules… or face the consequences Uncover disturbing lore through notes, tapes, and objects frozen in time from 2001 “Stanley says… don’t look behind you.” You’re not a kid anymore. But Stanley doesn’t care.
row.short_description: A first-person puzzle horror game set in a defunct children's nursery from 2001. Uncover dark secrets, solve mascot-themed puzzles, and survive the twisted games of Stanley—an animatronic who never stopped playing.
row.notes: The game includes some depictions of blood on the floor and objects, without bodies, corpses, or any indication of its source. In a final sequence, the player character kills the antagonist, Stanley.

row.name: Sexy Beaches
row.detailed_description: ABOUT THIS GAME Welcome to Sexy Beaches – the ultimate idle dating sim where business meets pleasure! Build, flirt, and conquer your way through a tropical paradise! As a savvy entrepreneur, you’ve arrived on a stunning archipelago where every island holds two treasures: lucrative business opportunities and gorgeous women waiting to be charmed. Impress them with gifts, sweet talk, and unforgettable dates. Unlock steamy rewards – The more they like you, the hotter the photos they’ll share… and if you play your cards right, you might get even closer during special events! FEATURES ✔ Build Your Paradise – Develop islands, manage resources, and watch your wealth grow! ✔ Date & Seduce – Over 10+ stunning girls, each with their own personality, desires, and spicy surprises. ✔ Gifts & Rewards – Shower them with presents to unlock flirty pics, intimate moments, and more! ✔ Special Events – Limited-time encounters with hardcore content – take your relationships to the next level! ✔ Idle Gameplay – Earn money and progress even when offline! ✔ Optional In-Game Purchases – Speed up your success if you’re feeling impatient. row.name: Wonders of the Deep
row.detailed_description: Embark on an underwater journey full of mystery, beauty, and discovery in Wonders of the Deep .   Dive into this third-person 3D adventure where you play as Coral , a young diver determined to continue her father's legacy and uncover the hidden secrets of Atlantis. With the guidance of her inseparable friend Marina from the surface, Coral will explore the ocean's depths, face imposing creatures like sharks, and solve ancient puzzles on her voyage into the unknown. In Wonders of the Deep , the ocean is both your ally and your enemy. Admire the beauty of marine life, venture into mysterious locations and sunken ruins, and uncover fragments of the past that will bring you closer to the truth behind the legendary lost city. Your journey will take you through vibrant and varied underwater environments: The Coral Garden , full of color and life. The Kelp Forest , where light barely pierces the dense algae. The Shipwreck , a mysterious sunken vessel filled with secrets. Atlantis , a mythical place hiding the greatest mystery of all. Key Features: Third-person underwater exploration with vibrant, lifelike, and immersive environments. Environmental and mechanical puzzles that unlock new areas and hidden secrets. Encounters with diverse marine wildlife , from peaceful fish to dangerous predators. Emotional, character-driven narrative , with engaging dialogues between Coral and Marina that deepen their story and relationship. Ruins of Atlantis , designed to evoke wonder and discovery at every turn.
row.short_description: Wonders of the Deep is a third-person underwater exploration adventure with puzzles, marine wildlife, and diving mechanics in a mysterious world.

row.name: Naja Medjai
row.detailed_description: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite combat game and 3D platformer set in a stylized, fictional Ancient Egypt. You play as Rosetta , a Medjai warrior chosen by fate and empowered by two ancient gods. With responsive, dodge-based combat and environmental platforming, Naja Medjai offers an accessible gateway into the challenging world of Souls-inspired games. 🎮 Core Gameplay Features ⚔️ Dodge-based melee combat with light/heavy attacks and readable patterns 🐫 Explore 3 distinct biomes : winding canyons, flooded ruins, and scorched settlements 🧠 Challenging boss battles with unique phases and mechanics 🧗 3D platforming across ancient puzzles, vertical spaces, and treacherous terrain 🧭 Semi-open world structure with unlockable areas and nonlinear progression 🕯️ Mythology-inspired narrative featuring gods like Ra, Set, Geb, Apophis, and Anubis 👪 Family-friendly design with accessible challenge and stylized visuals In this mythic reimagining of Ancient Egypt, Rosetta stands as the last hope for humanity. Blessed by Apophis , the serpent god of chaos, and Anubis , guardian of the afterlife, she is tasked with defeating corrupted pantheons. Under the scorching reign of Ra , the gods have abandoned mankind—until Rosetta rises to challenge the divine order. 🌄 The Winding Canyon – Path to Geb A vast, twisting canyon carved by time and turmoil. Navigate winding paths, leap across precarious ledges, and avoid treacherous oil pits that threaten to send you plunging into the depths. Ancient rock golems patrol the area, barraging you with crushing melee strikes and hurling deadly rocks from afar. Beware—the Earth God’s massive head periodically emerges from the canyon walls, unleashing devastating projectile attacks that keep you on edge. This rugged landscape tests your agility and wits before you face Geb’s overwhelming might. 🌍 Geb – The Unmoving Earth Don’t let his size fool you—Geb is anything but slow. This towering god lashes out with crushing melee strikes, hurls chunks of stone from afar, and dives underground to strike from unexpected angles. Adapt quickly, read the rumble beneath your feet, and keep moving—or get buried alive. ⚡ The Flooded City – Path to Set Traverse a tiered city swallowed by water and storm. Lightning elementals lurk in the depths, striking from the shadows as you navigate slippery walkways and crumbling platforms. The air crackles with electric tension, and the storm never ceases—only the swift and sharp survive this tempestuous domain. 🌪️ Set – Warden of Storm and Sand Set is a whirlwind of aggression. He darts across the arena in rapid 3-hit dash chains, unleashes crackling lightning orbs from his core, and summons storm clouds that restore his strength if left unchecked. Stay alert, manage the chaos, and shut down his healing before the desert claims you. 🌴 The Ghost Town – Path to Ra Once a thriving desert settlement, now scorched and silent under an eternal sun. The path to Ra winds through crumbling houses, charred statues, and haunting remnants of lives lost to fire. The oppressive heat radiates from cracked earth, while restless fire elementals flicker through the ruins, igniting bursts of flame that keep you on edge. The shadows grow longer with every step, drawing you deeper into Ra’s fiery domain. ☀️ Ra – Scorched Tyrant of the Sky Ra commands the battlefield with divine precision. He hurls scorching projectiles, sweeps massive arcs of flame, and ignites the ground beneath your feet. Periodically, he vanishes in a flash of light—then reappears across the arena, keeping pressure high and positioning critical. This is a fight of endurance and awareness—misstep once, and the sun god won’t give you a second chance. 🧩 Explore. Fight. Endure. Each boss defeated grants Rosetta new powers , found in ancient relics and godly artefacts . These enhance her strength and unlock new opportunities for traversal and combat. Progression is tied to mastery: learn from failure, adapt, and grow stronger. ✨ A Souls-lite for All Players Naja Medjai offers a gentle entry point into the world of Souls-inspired games. With readable patterns, forgiving checkpoints, and tight controls, it's an ideal challenge for younger players, genre newcomers, or fans looking for a more stylized and mythic experience .
row.short_description: Naja Medjai is a family-friendly Souls-lite 3D platformer set in a mythical Ancient Egypt. Play as Rosetta, a Medjai warrior blessed by Apophis and Anubis, as she battles corrupted gods to save humanity.

row.name: Dungeon CompAInions
row.detailed_description: In Dungeon CompAInions , the player can choose one of three playable classes: Mage, Druid, and Ranger. Each character comes equipped with a main attack weapon and two powerful abilities, which must be used strategically and wisely. The two remaining classes not chosen by the player will be controlled by agents trained through Reinforcement Learning and will accompany the player throughout their journey. Together, the player and their AI companions must clear rounds composed of multiple enemy waves. Each round consists of five waves, which are triggered continuously during gameplay—unless the player decides to activate the pause button midway through the round. Pausing the game will damage, potentially even kill, the player. This allows for clearing the remaining enemies and helps with not being overrun by hordes of undead. The player will get score for every initiated wave, stacking up with the number of waves cleared without pausing. Thus, the player should choose wisely between staying safe and pausing the game, or being greedy and trying to clear all enemies without a moment of peace. After completing a round, the player will be presented with three reward options, from which one may be selected. These rewards include upgrades to Attack Damage or Ability Damage, increases in Max Health, reductions in cooldown times, or boosts to movement speed. These upgrades are essential for survival and success. With every subsequent round, the game becomes progressively more challenging. Enemy strength increases, spawn rates accelerate, and wave intervals become shorter—down to a predefined minimum. This creates a dynamic balance between becoming stronger and facing ever-larger groups of enemies, ensuring the player is constantly tested in both strategy and combat efficiency.
row.short_description: In Dungeon CompAInions, choose a class—Mage, Druid, or Ranger—while AI-controlled allies help you survive waves of enemies. Pause to slow the pace at a cost, or push on for higher scores. Earn upgrades after each round as difficulty steadily increases.

row.name: a pig game: A Pee Wee Premiere
row.detailed_description: Collect Your Toothpicks! Life’s pretty straightforward when you’re a ceramic toothpick holder. But what’s a pig to do in a brand new kitchen? That'll take the help of some new friends and a couple well-timed acrobatic feats! Gameplay Features Overview Unique Acrobatic Platforming Mechanics Complete Missions, Puzzles, Racing, and Platforming Challenges Features Responsive Tutorials and Visible Input Displays Wholesome and Charming NPC Dialogue Interactions Unlock Exciting New Ways to Traverse the Kitchen! Explore a Beautiful Detailed Kitchen Environment Menu Setting Options, Auto Saving Rich Environmental Audio and Dynamic Music Full Gamepad Controller Support Meet Your New Countertop Companions  This kitchen is full of countertop characters who can't wait to meet the newest arrival! (it's you!) Explore a Culinary World From a Whole New Perspective  As the saying goes, 'The world is your toothpick!'- or that's what this piggy toothpick holder tells us (we'll have to fact check him on it). Flip, Fling, and Fly Your Way to Daring New Heights!  Begin fun and challenging quests as you meet new friends and discover all new ways to explore the kitchen from top to bottom! After all, 'There are toothpicks everywhere for those with eyes to see!' (okay, that one can't be true) About the History and Inspiration Usually music is made for the game. This game was made for the music. row.short_description: Join Pee Wee the Polka Dotted Pig - your silent (but determined) ceramic protagonist on a mission to collect toothpicks! Flip, fling, and fly through a kitchen full of cozy characters and curious quests!

row.name: Fourmiworld
row.detailed_description: 'In times of boredom, there's only one logical thing to do...                                      ...travel to another dimension, recreationally!'                                                      - A. Wandereye (probably) Fourmiworld Fourmiworld is a free game all about exploring a strange world orbiting a dying star. Along the way you'll discover the remains of a lost civilization, encounter bizarre creatures, unlock tools to aid your expedition, and more. If you'd like to support us, consider checking out the Wandereye's Writings DLC . It isn't necessary, but we recommend it if you want the definitive Fourmiworld experience. Should you play? If you enjoy at least 7 of the following points , we think you'll really click with Fourmiworld : Games with destructible environments and secrets to discover.​ Open-world exploration and nonlinear progression. Insects , bugs and Sci-Fi ecosystems. Piecing together the history of a long-gone alien race. Atypical artstyles , collage, girls with flowers for eyes. Growing stronger and gaining abilities to better navigate your environment. Games that don't hold your hand and just let you figure things out. Atmospheric , ambient music that adapts to where you are. Personalized experiences, seeing things other players will not see. The word 'Frondosity' invokes a certain joy in you. Inspirations These games inspired us a lot during development. We think you should give the game a try if you enjoy at least two of these: Metroid - Game-altering upgrades & lonesome alien atmosphere. Terraria - Digging anywhere & obtaining resources to get new abilities. Hylics - Surrealistic stylization & unconventional vibe. Yume Nikki - Exploring exactly how you want to & seeing weird/cool/scary things. Starseed Pilgrim - Lack of hand-holding & tile interaction aspects.
row.short_description: Carve your own path through Fourmiworld - an 'open-world-ant-farm-metroidvania'. Play as an interdimensional urban explorer girl, collect Gamut to unlock new abilities, and discover the sights, plights, & soundbites of a surreal alien dimension.

row.name: The River
row.detailed_description: You wake up in the void, with no memory other than the deep sense that something horrible has happened to you in life that has left you in limbo. row.name: Heist.exe

row.name: 逆転探偵

row.name: Everranger
row.detailed_description: This is a moderately challenging single-player minimalist 2D puzzle game with approximately 100 levels. In the game, you control your piece (an hourglass) to evade or capture other pieces according to game mechanics, ultimately reaching the target point. Different pieces follow distinct movement logic that isn't explicitly revealed - you must deduce these patterns through exploration and observation. Most levels are grouped in series of 10. Within each series, difficulty gradually increases: earlier levels serve as tutorials for core mechanics, while later levels present greater challenges that may require extended problem-solving. Although appearing turn-based (with enemy pieces reacting after your moves before awaiting your next action), the game actually operates in real-time. Each piece enters a cooldown period after moving, creating dynamic puzzle scenarios where enemy pieces might execute multiple moves in response to your actions. While the compact game allows free selection of any level (no progression locks), sequential play is recommended for optimal experience progression.
row.short_description: This is a moderately challenging single-player 2D puzzle game with approximately 100 levels. You control your piece to evade or capture other pieces, ultimately reaching the target point. Different pieces follow distinct movement logic. You must deduce these patterns through exploration.

row.name: Fracctal TCG
row.detailed_description: Fuse Pokémon-style creatures with Hearthstone-inspired combat in this fast, strategic card battler. Build 30-card elemental decks, level your cards mid-match, and climb the ranked ladder through Solo quests, PvP duels, automated tournaments, and seasonal events. About This Game Fracctal TCG distills the thrill of monster collecting into a one-versus-one card game built for quick, tactical showdowns. Choose from eight elemental teams —like Fire, Ice, Plant, Rock, Psychic, Electric, and more. Master mono-element decks or blend types for clever combos. Hearthstone-like resource curve. Both players start at 2 mana and gain +1 per turn (max 10), keeping matches brisk without runaway snowballing. 30-card decks, 20 HP, fairy hero powers. Every draw matters; teched counters and tempo swings decide the match in under ten minutes. Card evolution. Let a creature survive three of your turns and it morphs into a stronger form—protect it or pay the price. Hero powers (Fairy skills). Fire blasts damage, Plant heals, Rock builds armor, Psychic forces discards, and more—one use per turn, so timing is everything. Level-up progression. Win games, complete daily quests, and earn currency to enhance your favorite cards or unlock fresh archetypes. Solo & PvP content. Tutorial Mode that teaches core mechanics. Practice and level up your skills in Solo Mode. Ranked PvP Ladder with seasonal resets and cosmetic rewards. Automated & Custom Tournaments Compete in daily or weekly automated tournaments for in-game currency, rare cards, or cosmetic rewards. He promises to pay a reward to whoever defeats the Demon King first. To save his family's finances (albeit reluctantly), he sets out on a journey to defeat the Demon King. What's Go? Stunning graphical effects. Dress-up items. Battles with monsters. All the essential elements of a fantasy RPG are packed into this game. In Chapter 1, you will learn the rules and basics, while the upcoming Chapter 2 (the final chapter) will provide more advanced tactics and lessons on the 19x19 board. row.name: GodsArena Online
row.detailed_description: GodsArena is a dream project brought to life by our small independent team, inspired by the golden age of classic MMORPGs. Our mission was to recapture the spirit of true MMORPG gameplay, while adapting it to the pace of modern players who may not have 10+ hours a day to spare. So, what is GodsArena ? At its core, it features four unique classes — Mage, Warrior, Champion, and Priest — each with their own distinctive playstyle, abilities, and strengths. All classes are carefully balanced for thrilling PvP battles and efficient monster hunting across the open world. But your hero won’t be alone. Pets play a crucial role in battle — choose from dozens of companions, each with unique traits and skills. Pets grow stronger, level up, and learn new abilities, often turning the tide of combat. For collectors, there’s the option to own multiple pets and work toward a full collection. Mounts are also at your disposal — not just for faster travel across the expansive world, but also for enhancing your character’s stats. Mounts can be upgraded and equipped with special gear that directly boosts your performance in combat. The world of GodsArena is inspired by ancient Greece and divided into two warring factions: Athens and Sparta. When creating a character, you’ll choose your allegiance and engage in an ongoing struggle for dominance and resources through large-scale PvP events. PvE enthusiasts will find a rich variety of instances and dungeons, offering both solo and group content with powerful bosses and valuable loot. Crafting and economic systems provide opportunities to gather resources, create useful items, and trade them on the in-game marketplace. For players who love character progression, GodsArena offers an extensive enhancement system. Unlike many other games, your gear doesn’t become obsolete as you level up — it can be upgraded and improved without losing any prior investment. You can also level up your skills, pets, mounts, and core attributes, making every character truly one of a kind. GodsArena is constantly evolving, and even now offers: • Over 50 maps for PvP and PvE battles • Dozens of dungeons • A wide range of events and seasonal content Join us and become part of the legend in the world of GodsArena !
row.short_description: GodsArena is a dream game created by our small independent team inspired by classic MMORPGs. Four playable classes, a wide variety of pets, dungeons, maps, and of course — fierce rivals!

row.name: Tag! You're Dead
row.detailed_description: Tag! You're Dead is a fast-paced, side-scrolling horror arcade game where every second you survive makes the game harder. Inspired by the FOUND TV film demo_n , this one-button nightmare drops you into a glitch-ridden world full of collapsing platforms, demonic traps, and sudden jump scares. You tap, dash, and jump to stay alive as the screen speeds up and the pressure builds. The farther you get, the faster it goes—and the more twisted the game becomes. At first, it seems simple: dodge obstacles, survive the demons, and climb the leaderboard. But very quickly, you'll find yourself in a state of full-panic reflexes as the speed increases, the visuals distort, and the enemies become relentless. It’s brutal, fast, and addictively fun —a game that dares you to try “just one more run” even after your 20th crash. There are no checkpoints. No second chances. Just your instincts and a steadily unraveling nightmare trying to catch you. What Makes It Unique: One-button twitch gameplay Creepy found footage horror aesthetic Demons that get faster and smarter the longer you last Retro glitch visuals and VHS-style effects Original horror soundtrack that builds with intensity Tag! You're Dead is perfect for fans of Geometry Dash , Flappy Bird , or anyone who wants a creepy, high-score arcade challenge that feels different every time. How far can you go before the shadows catch you?

From writing parking tickets in quiet suburbs to breaking up dangerous drug rings and surviving magical shootouts, your rise through the ranks begins now. Explore Four Unique Districts: Hannara – Human-dominated suburban streets with minor infractions and neighborhood disputes. Morgatelis – Glittering skyscrapers housing wealthy elves and goblins—and the white-collar crimes they commit. DelDedria – A gritty, dangerous zone home to orcs and humans, where gang violence and illegal deals run rampant. Colezaria – An industrial wasteland policed with grit, where orc laborers and criminal rings clash in the factories. Gameplay & Features: 🛡️ Tier-Based Crime Response Tier 1 (Low-Risk) : Chase down fleeing suspects such as graffiti artists, write parking tickets, and detain petty criminals using handcuffs. Tier 2 (Medium-Risk) : Use your trusty baton to break up street fights, control vandalism, and disarm and detain drug dealers. Tier 3 (High-Risk) : Gear up with a pistol and deploy a futuristic shield to face magical shootouts, bomb threats, and organized bank robberies. 🎖️ Level Up Your Officer Earn XP and credits by resolving crimes correctly—non-lethal takedowns and appropriate force earn bigger rewards. Level up to take on more dangerous assignments, access higher crime tiers, and unlock perks and cosmetics. 🚓 Customize Your Loadout Spend your hard-earned credits on: Weapon camos for your pistol and baton New police vehicles including high-speed cars and bikes Weapon upgrades such as ranged and melee damage output as well as magazine size 🎰 Live the Off-Duty Life Take a break from justice and explore city life: Hit the casino and try your luck at four unique table games using the credits you earn in game Socialize with NPCs, explore district cultures 🔓 Master Your Role Climb from rookie patrol to elite enforcer. row.name: Hollowing
row.detailed_description: 《Hollowing》 is a first person perspective pixel style psychological horror game that focuses on immersive experiences of narrative exploration and eerie atmosphere. You will play the role of an international student studying alone in a foreign country, attending classes on campus during the day and returning to a dim and silent apartment at night, repeating a meaningless life day after day. In this closed and lonely environment, time gradually becomes blurred, and reality and illusion begin to intersect. The shadow outside the window is getting closer and closer, and the whispers at night are becoming clearer. Is something approaching or is your mind collapsing? The main gameplay of the game is first person interactive exploration, which unlocks the character's inner world and story clues through walking, observing, and interacting with objects. The game is mainly driven by the plot, with a strong narrative progression as the main axis, advancing day by day, feeling the character's psychological state gradually collapsing, bringing you a psychologically terrifying experience The inspiration for the story comes from the loneliness and cultural barriers experienced by real international students. The game has no combat system and focuses on psychological stress and environmental narrative. This will be a journey about anxiety, loneliness, and the breakdown of self-awareness. What exactly are you facing? A real monster? Or is it just a projection of your inner self? flee? Or face it? This gradually distorted daily routine is waiting for you to uncover the truth. This is my first game，please enjoy.

row.name: Before the End
row.detailed_description: Before the End is a 2D top-down grid-based puzzle game taking place during prehistoric times. In each level, the player must reach the goal to pass time and move ever closer towards the anticipated extinction of the dinosaurs. Within each level, you will utilize strange quantum powers to manipulate natural objects by swapping them amongst each other. You will also find yourself less alone as you play, recruiting an expanding cast of dinosaur friends to help you manipulate the environment in new and layered ways. Explore an expansive world by progressing through 70 increasingly difficult levels spread through a variety of natural environments. Witness what lies ahead and determine what you can accomplish in the time before the end? This game was originally created by Jodi Foster as an undergraduate Honors Thesis at the University of Florida.
row.short_description: Before the End is a grid-based puzzle game that follows the dinosaurs during the time just before their extinction. Interact with the environment and manipulate strange quantum powers to progress through the natural world. What can you achieve in the time before the end?

row.name: Line Hopper
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Line Hopper! In this unique game (the first 1st-person 2D platformer ever created), you get to see what a two-dimensional world composed of multicolored lines looks like from the perspective of the main character, Linus. Whereas you and I see our 3D world as a series of 2D images, Linus sees his 2D world in one dimension: as a single vertical line! Piecing together what is going on from his vantage point is challenging at first, but once you've gotten used to it, you'll be surprised how much you are able to see! Black and purple lines represent every-day obstacles that you can walk on, jump off of, and slide against. Red lines are enemies, and the goal of each level is to reach the green line. When you reach a yellow line, you get to see the full level from a 2D perspective for as long as you remain in contact with it; otherwise, you and Linus are on your own! Comes with a tool to create your own levels! (A multiplayer mode for this game is currently under development.)

row.name: Sanatorium – A Mental Asylum Simulator Playtest
Die. Respawn. Repeat.
row.detailed_description: You’re a circle. Everything else wants you gone. But every time you die, you leave something behind — a glowing shield, a permanent upgrade, a memory of failure turned into a tool for survival. Die. Upgrade. Try again. In this neon-lit bullet hell, every death creates a persistent upgrade that stays on the battlefield — blocking bullets, shaping new strategies, and gradually turning chaos into rhythm. This is a small, free game I made during a game jam. I liked the vibe, so I decided to polish it up and share it here on Steam. It’s short, weird, and (hopefully) satisfying. No microtransactions, no fluff — just you, the shapes, and the bullets.
row.short_description: A fast-paced, minimalist bullet hell where dying makes you stronger. Originally made for a game jam, now polished and released as a free standalone.
