row.name: Bass Harrier
row.detailed_description: New Mixtape mode Available! Preselected arcade runs are now available to play. Can you unlock the secret Forbidden Tape? About the Game Bass Harrier is an electrifying fusion of rhythm and arcade shooting, where the beat controls the battlefield. Even if you've never played a rhythm game or a shmup before, you'll quickly get into the groove! Enemies, environments, and even the lights react to the music, creating a dynamic experience where timing is everything. Instead of memorizing complex patterns, just feel the beat—your movements and attacks sync naturally with the soundtrack. Whether you're dodging waves of enemies or unleashing powerful shots, the music guides you. No prior experience needed—just jump in, follow the rhythm, and let the game pull you into its pulse-pounding world! In the land of Vasta, rhythm is life—and one prince holds the key to keeping the beat alive. With his boundless talent and unwavering spirit, he spreads music, color, and joy to all who listen. But today, the groove is under siege. A band of unscrupulous disruptors has emerged from the shadows, striking at the heart of the kingdom’s rhythm. Their chaos threatens to silence the pulse that drives Vasta, turning harmony into discord. But the prince? He’s not about to let the music die. Armed with his rhythm, courage, and an unstoppable beat, he sets out to reclaim the soul of the land. Every step, every note, every perfectly timed attack sends a message—this groove won’t break. The battle for Vasta isn’t just a fight—it’s a performance. And the stage is set for the most electrifying showdown the world has ever seen. Will the groove prevail? Or will the silence take hold? This summer, prepare to feel the rhythm like never before. Play your way: Dive into Play Album , a classic arcade mode that lets you experience full musical journeys; Explore the Mixtape Mode , where various routes remix your adventure in surprising ways; Or fine-tune your skills in Singletrack , perfect for practicing specific levels. And if you think you’re skilled enough to unlock a secret mixtape route—well, let’s just say, Vasta doesn’t hand out VIP passes easily.
row.short_description: Bass Harrier is a rhythm-fueled shoot 'em up. This world is powered by the Riddim of the music—enemy spawns, environments, and even the lights shift dynamically to the stage's soundtrack. No need for prior experience—just follow the beat, dodge threats, and fire away!

row.name: A Better Tomorrow
row.detailed_description: Rabies erupts without warning, rupturing the young policeman’s placid existence. row.name: JustRun

row.short_description: 'Just Run' is a very simple platform jumping game that only requires movement and jumping to complete the entire process. The key point is a simple jumping adventure, using the props of the scene to interact and reach the end.

row.name: 三国往事：季汉之魂 Playtest
Zombie Ants VR: Definitive Edition
row.detailed_description: Zombie Ants VR is a short (5-10 minute) educational experience that takes the player through the life cycle of Ophiocordyceps, a fungus that manipulates the behavior of insects (in this case ants) in order to increase the spread of its spores. This fungus was a large inspiration for the video game series Last of Us and is often referred to as the 'Zombie Fungus'. The game offers several different control schemes to accommodate all sorts of players from those who have never used VR before to those who want a more interactive experience. There is also a motion sickness option. Educational content of the game is recommended for ages 12+, but may be suitable for younger audiences. Zombie Ants VR was created by a large collaborative effort between researchers, student, and recent-graduates of the University of Central Florida (UCF) biology, game development, and acting departments as well as the University of Utrecht (UU) biology, computer science, and arts departments. It was supported by NSF Career 1941546, made available to Charissa de Bekker, and internal funding form Utrecht University, made available to William C. Beckerson.

row.name: Laugh Track
row.detailed_description: Welcome To Your New Job You're now the lead writer for Juno's World, a perfectly normal sitcom in which nothing strange or horrible happens, ever! We're so happy you've chosen permanent employment. Management has infinite faith in your ability to steer our production team towards our mysterious and important endgame. You'll be guiding four teenagers -- Juno, Cat, Daniel, and Remy -- through the trials and travails of high school life. Using our patented 'Ratings(tm)' system, you'll make decisions that keep them entertainingly unhappy! But not too unhappy, or they'll break. But also not too relaxed, or they'll fight back. We can't have that, no! How will we ever reach syndication if the entire project collapses? Game Features A visual novel from the creators of Arcade Spirits, Penny Larceny, and The Shadow Over Cyberspace! Four human teens with Teen Problems!  And one hamster. Can you help them find their way? Eight episodes of wacky shenanigans and soul-crushing real-world drama! You choose the episode order, you choose who to focus on! Relationships, romances, and ratings -- all leading to the ending you desire! Will you fight back against Management, or comply with the job? Classical cartoony visuals and music, to tickle your nostalgia bones! Full text-to-speech support for disability access, using NVDA if available! Just tap the V key to activate before you start a new game. The promise of utter annihilation if you fail in your task! Doesn't that sound like fun? I Would Like To Decline This Opportunity Please You don't want to be part of an eternal cosmic hive mind, yoked to your typewriter, forced to tune sitcom scripts until your continued existence is determined to be redundant and your soul gets re-absorbed into Management? You want out...? There is no out . There is only in . Welcome to Laugh Track. A free game (with optional donation) coming to your PC in early 2026 from Fiction Factory Games, creators of Arcade Spirits, Penny Larceny, and the Shadow Over Cyberspace.

row.detailed_description: 我們 被笑， 　　我們 不被看好， 　　但我們 不怕！ 　　我們都需要「勇氣Online」... 「勇氣Online」是一款由 開發的 2D 奇幻 MMORPG 遊戲，免費開玩。 遊戲背景設定在群雄割據的「戰國七雄」時期。戰火紛飛之下，齊、韓、趙、魏、秦、楚、燕七國爭霸不休，天下動盪。而一場來自天外的神秘天石撞擊，揭開了埋藏千年的秘密，喚醒了沉睡的妖魔，也點燃了人間煉獄的序章。 玩家將在溫馨可愛的東方武俠畫風中，扮演一位身負使命的英雄，體驗仗劍天下、斬妖除魔的熱血旅程，或是在國戰沙場上成就一方霸業！搭配超萌寵物、酷炫坐騎、溫馨門派和熱血部落，展開仿 3D 即時戰鬥、隊伍群P、部落戰爭、國戰爭霸等多元玩法。 ＊遊戲特色＊ 門派系統：多種多樣的門派設定，從剛猛的禁衛軍、堅韌的桃花源，到詭譎的唐門、靈法並施的蜀山，以及專精輔助與法術的雲夢澤、茅山與崑崙山，滿足各類玩家的戰鬥風格與職業喜好。 寵物系統：捕捉怪物為寵物，並培養牠們成長，幫助您徵戰沙場。 婚姻系統：與伴侶共同探險，體驗浪漫的冒險旅程。 武器製作：製作超級武器，鍛造升星、鑲嵌寶石提升屬性。 部落戰爭、國戰爭霸：玩家可透過僱用傭兵戰士、建造箭樓等方式擴展自身實力，在幫會戰爭中爭取更多利益，體驗 DOTA 的策略與對抗兼具的大型戰場樂趣。 ＊七大門派＊ 禁衛軍：偏重物理攻擊的門派，擅長使用槍與棍為武器，攻勢凌厲。 桃花源：近身肉搏型門派，擁有全門派中最高的防禦力，使用拳套作戰。 唐門：擅長遠程物理攻擊，以身法靈活著稱，以暗器與毒物為主要武器。 蜀山：兼具物理與法術攻擊能力，武器分為刀與劍兩種，萬法歸一。 雲夢澤：擅長回復與增益法術的輔助門派，使用劍作為武器。 茅山：專注於鬼神召喚與法術攻擊，以劍形法器施展各種術法。 崑崙山：以強力法術攻擊見長，擁有豐富多樣的法術技能，武器為劍。 馬上加入「勇氣Online」－－戰國的傳說，由你親手書寫！

row.name: Cry Of Monster
row.detailed_description: Cry of Monster is a 2D survival horror game with a pixel art style that immerses you in an experience filled with tension, mystery, and gore. You control a young woman in an abandoned city, searching for her best friend who vanished under unsettling circumstances. In this short game (1 hour), you must solve puzzles, execute mechanics, explore environments, and face grotesque monsters. Main Features: Engaging Story: Uncover the truth behind your friend's disappearance through an emotional narrative full of unexpected twists. Survival and Puzzles: Use your wits to solve environmental puzzles and escape deadly traps while managing limited resources to survive. Multiple Gore Deaths: Every mistake can lead to one of many brutal and visually striking deaths. Pixel Art Style: Enjoy retro 2D art that blends nostalgia with an oppressive atmosphere, complemented by a haunting soundtrack and sound effects. Will you find your friend and escape alive, or become prey to the unknown? Warning: This game contains explicit gore content, including graphic violence and bloody deaths, which may not be suitable for all audiences.
row.short_description: Everything fell apart. People started getting sick… not in a normal way. Now the city is desolate, and the only thing that matters is finding out if your best friend is still alive. You'll have to explore, run, hide, and face the contamination.
row.notes: Cry of Monster contains mature content focused on moderate violence and gore elements, presented in a retro pixel art style that heightens the horror atmosphere. Players will encounter combat scenes against deformed creatures, with depictions of blood and graphically intense deaths that occur when failing puzzles or being caught by enemies, reinforcing the tension of the survival horror experience. The narrative explores a dark story about failed scientific experiments, with an oppressive atmosphere and psychological horror elements that may be unsettling for some players. There are no depictions of sexual content, sexual abuse, non-consensual sex, drug or alcohol abuse, or self-harm in the game. However, the combination of violence, gore, and themes of human experimentation may not be suitable for all audiences, particularly those sensitive to blood or psychologically disturbing environments.

row.name: 今夜无人入眠 No One Sleep Tonight
row.detailed_description: No One Sleeps Tonight is a game consisting of multiple midnight scenes. You will travel through several environments with unique gameplay and styles to experience different nighttime emotions. The game includes dozen unique scenes, each representing a character's experience under the cover of night. You could be a sniper waiting for your target on the battlefield, a child sneaking out of the room at midnight, or a traveler waiting for a bus to come in the rain. In addition to the differences between environments, each scene also has different gameplay and ending conditions. Will you drive a speeding car on a rainy mountain road, or walk quietly down a silent alley in search of your destination? Every choice you make during the night may unlock new items and lead you to the next moonlit space. We hope that each experience will remind you of your own nighttime emotions. And then, have a good NIGHT.
row.short_description: No One Sleep Tonight is a game that focuses on the feeling of Night. You will go through multiple midnight scenes and experience different environments and gameplay, explore this world created by street lamp, moonlight, and wind.

row.name: Ruarua.ru
row.detailed_description: This is a small indie game, created with passion despite the many challenges along the way. It may not have the polish and grandeur of big productions, but I hope it can bring you a moment of lighthearted joy. Ruarua.ru will continue to be updated and improved, striving to offer all explorers a better experience. A long-term farming project that always accompanies you... Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that that always accompanies you, It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time. Here, you can not only make many friends, communicate and play together, but also slowly accumulate resources through playing, and gain a full sense of accomplishment. In Ruarua.ru , you take on the role of an Explorer , embarking on an adventurous journey filled with battles against monsters and the collection of loot cards . You can choose Free Mode , where you actively hunt down monsters to initiate combat, or opt for Explore Mode , where you wait for the next wave of monsters and respond strategically. Of course, there are many other ways to obtain cards as well! Each card has its own unique function — some generate a steady flow of resources, while others enhance your combat skills and performance. As you gather more cards, you can combine lower-tier cards into more powerful higher-tier ones, and equip them to strengthen your abilities. As you grow stronger, you'll gradually unlock access to more dangerous and mysterious places, encounter a variety of NPCs, and uncover more stories and challenges waiting to be revealed. Explorers, let’s set off on this journey together!
row.short_description: Ruarua.ru is a long-term farming project that always accompanies you... It is a simple farming game that can be played anytime and anywhere when you have free time.

row.name: Kana no Mado
row.detailed_description: Kana no Mado - Plus is here! 🎉 Kana no Mado – Plus is here! Looking to go further with your kana reading? Kana no Mado – Plus adds advanced kana, JLPT vocabulary with kanji and furigana, more quiz options, and full voice audio by a native speaker. A perfect upgrade if you’ve enjoyed the free app! About the Game Kana no Mado – Learn to Read Japanese Kana no Mado (“The Kana Window”) is a calm, distraction-free app that helps you learn to read Japanese kana – the hiragana and katakana characters used in everyday written Japanese. Focused purely on reading, this free version lets you recognize, hear, and read kana using structured lessons and quizzes. No writing, grammar, or distractions – just the reading practice you need to get started. Perfect for beginners and beyond From complete beginners to those who just want to brush up, Kana no Mado makes it easy to learn or review kana reading, your way. Each kana is introduced with sound, supported by examples and reading quizzes you can replay at your own pace. Get used to how kana really look Kana in the real world don’t always look like textbook characters. In Kana no Mado , each character can be displayed in three fonts – a clear print style, a handwritten variant, and a Mincho-style font used in books and signs. What’s included for free LEARN Hiragana – The Basics Learn to read basic hiragana characters with native audio. Katakana – The Basics Learn to read basic katakana characters with native audio. Hiragana Variants & Katakana Variants Practice voiced and combined kana, with instant feedback. PRACTICE Hiragana Quiz – Beginner Drill beginner hiragana at your own pace. Katakana Quiz – Beginner Test beginner katakana with no pressure. Listening Quiz – Kana Train your ear with simple kana sounds. Available in multiple languages English, French, Spanish, German, Simplified Chinese Want to go further? All the core kana content is free. But if you want to practice with real words, track your progress, and unlock new learning and quiz modes, the Kana no Mado Plus DLC has even more to offer.
row.short_description: Learn to read Japanese hiragana and katakana with this calm and focused educational app. Practice kana recognition through sound and visual quizzes. No writing or grammar - just reading practice at your own pace. Ideal for beginners in Japanese.

row.name: Don't Fall
row.detailed_description: Don't Fall – A Game of Balance and Timing Stack it. Balance it. Survive. row.name: Kingless Dungeon
row.detailed_description: Description: Kingless Dungeon is a fast-paced Hack and Slash action platformer that invites the player to explore an ancient and dark dungeon, taking on the role of its master: a Prince of Shadows who believes himself to be the hero of this world, as his memory has been altered by an unfortunate accident. Instead of delving deeper into the dungeon, the player must find a way out after concluding that the main threat has already been eliminated. This is a university project developed by a group of student at the Complutense University of Madrid (UCM) , as their first game during their freshman year.  Please note that the game does not include a save system , but the full experience can be completed in approximately 30 minutes . Story: In the darkest corner of the Kingdom, in the Dungeon of Shadows, resides the Villain — the infamous Prince of Shadows — whose loyal servants terrorize the world. The Villain rarely leaves his lair, but all know of his fearsome powers, rivaled only by the strength of the Hero. However, not even the Prince’s abilities could defy the elementary laws of gravity. The Villain slipped and hit the ground while descending the dungeon stairs, lost his memories, and awoke confused at the foot of his throne. Alone in a massive chamber, he believed himself to be the hero who had just defeated the dungeon boss. “Victorious,” he decided to leave the dungeon, bravely fighting his way out — unaware that he was slaying his own minions and loyal servants. Open source: The game is open source on GitHub, so you're welcome to submit your own ideas, creativity, or participate in development! Project lead: .../Proyectos1-FDI-UCM/c2425-Grupo03 Completely Free! This game is entirely free to play, so there's no reason not to give it a try! Its main purpose is to showcase our university project.
row.short_description: 《Kingless Dungeon》 is a 2D hack and slash platformer where you control the Shadow Prince, a warrior with no memory. Fight undead enemies, discover your skills, and explore this deep dungeons filled with traps and secrets. Can you reclaim your memories and escape?

row.name: Ignis Dei
row.detailed_description: Foretold by a comet, which many regarded as a harbinger of doom, the Black Death reached Florence in 1348. The epidemic spread rapidly, killing a large portion of the population and leaving a profound impact on European society, economy, and culture. Ignis Dei is a puzzle-horror game inspired by the aforementioned events. The player will find themselves wandering through a forest to escape the plague, solving various puzzles, interacting with mysterious creatures, exploring, observing, and becoming lost in dark and haunting environments. What fate awaits them? EXPLORATION Every step will lead you into the unknown. PUZZLES Interact with the Messanges. MYSTERY Discover what lies behind the arrivial of the comet. Of the great mortality and famine that befell Florence and its surroundings, and of a comet that appeared. In the year 1348, at the end of March, a comet appeared in the sky toward the east, at the end of the sign of Virgo and the beginning of Libra—both human signs, signifying great affliction and death upon human bodies, as we shall say hereafter. The comet itself lasted only a few days, but many evils followed its ominous signs, especially upon our city of Florence. Soon after, a great mortality began, such that those who fell ill scarcely survived. More than a sixth of the citizens died, and many were the best and most beloved—both men and women. No family was spared, with two, three, or more members perishing. The plague lasted until the coming winter. ( Giovanni Villani, Nuova Cronica. Florence, 1348 ) DISCLAIMER Ignis Dei was originally made for the Spaghetti Horror 2025 Game Jam, as such it is a short game aimed to entertain you for about 30 minutes. Some improvements have been made for the Steam release but you might encounters bugs and some parts of the game might appear unfinished due to the short development time. We hope you will enjoy the experience nonetheless.
row.short_description: Heralded by a comet, seen as a harbinger of doom, the Black Death arrived in Florence in 1348. Wander through the woods to escape the plague, face various riddles and encounter mysterious creatures.

row.name: First Steps in Learning about Pregnancy
row.detailed_description: Welcome to “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Daihoku Area Edition”! This serious game (an educational game designed to address social issues) lets players learn about daily life during pregnancy and the local support systems available. You play as the main character who has just learned she’s pregnant and experience her journey while interacting with her partner, medical professionals, and family. Based on information from the Matsumoto–Daihoku region in Nagano Prefecture, the game naturally introduces local medical systems and support programs. Enjoy the story while deepening your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth. ⸻ Game Features • Experience Pregnancy Through an Interactive Story Play as a woman in early pregnancy and go through daily events such as managing physical changes, attending prenatal checkups, joining parenting classes, and preparing for childbirth. Medical and administrative knowledge is woven naturally into the story. • Branching Choices That Influence the Story The narrative changes depending on your choices in conversations and actions. Each option is accompanied by explanations so that players can learn the appropriate responses through gameplay. • Realistic Settings Based on Local Information Local resources from Matsumoto, Omachi, and Azumino cities are featured, including maternal and child health handbooks, medical expense subsidies, hometown deliveries, and postpartum care. ⸻ Highlights • Approx. 1-hour playtime with save/load functions • Suitable not only for pregnant individuals but also for healthcare students, educators, high school students, and those considering pregnancy • Learn about the social systems that support pregnancy and childbirth in an engaging way ⸻ Development Background This game was developed with support from the Nagano Prefectural “Regional Vitality Promotion Fund.” It was planned and supervised by a pediatrician from the Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine, with contributions from medical students and childcare support volunteers. It is widely used as an educational tool to help people understand the real-life flow of medical and welfare services. ⸻ Recommended For • Pregnant individuals • Students and young people interested in pregnancy and childbirth • Educators and professionals in childcare and welfare • Those with pregnant partners or family members • Anyone interested in learning about local support systems ⸻ Development Team • Developer: M-Terrace • Supervision: Matsumoto–Daihoku Regional Birth and Childcare Safety Network Council • Planning: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University School of Medicine (Dr. Yukihide Miyosawa) ⸻ Medical Disclaimer This game is intended for educational and awareness purposes only. It does not substitute for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. If you are experiencing health concerns or unusual symptoms, please consult a physician or midwife. ⸻ Begin your journey through pregnancy in the beautiful natural surroundings and warm support of Shinshu. Deepen your understanding of pregnancy and childbirth with “First Pregnancy: Matsumoto–Ōhoku Area Edition.”
row.short_description: Play as a pregnant woman experiencing daily life from early pregnancy to childbirth prep. Learn about local medical and support systems through interactive choices. Features 1-hour playtime and save/load. Great for those interested in healthcare, education, or social welfare

row.name: Enrobssyba
row.detailed_description: Abyssborne is a dark fantasy roguelite Abyssborne thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power. Master Dynamic Combat Engage in fast-paced, reactive combat where every strike matters. Face a wide variety of unique enemies and grow stronger with each battle. Grow Stronger with Every Step Progress through the ever-changing dungeon, unlock new abilities, and evolve your playstyle. Each run brings you closer to mastering the darkness. Uncover the Secrets of the Abyss Progress deeper into the dungeon to piece together the cryptic story. Discover hidden letters and uncover the dark mysteries buried within the Abyss.
row.short_description: Enrobssyba is a dark fantasy roguelite that thrusts you into a shadowed, ever-changing dungeon, teeming with enemies, upgrades, and untold power.

The overall atmosphere is dark and may include suggestive themes related to corruption, despair, and survival in a hostile universe. There is no sexual content, substance abuse, or extremely sensitive themes.

row.name: Bartholomew.exe
row.detailed_description: Can you survive the nightmare and take control of the dream? You wake up in the maze of the monster - Bartholomew. In this maze, reality shifts between nightmare and dream , a constant cat and mouse chase where you take contrasting roles in each state. During the Dream State you will need to chase Bartholomew and try your best to put him down with your trusty revolver however you need to be quick before the nightmare state begins anew. In the Nightmare State, You are disarmed and hunted, the only viable options are your traps that can help slow down the monstrosity chasing you. Collect the coins scattered along the maze so you can buy upgrades for your revolver and additional traps to kill the beast faster. Don't stop running, don't stop hunting. HE. IS. Bartholomew...
row.short_description: In this short FPS horror experience you are thrown into a maze where the game's state shifts between Nightmare and Dream, you are hunted by the monster Bartholomew in the nightmare and you get to hunt him in the dream. Upgrade your revolver, stock up on traps and kill Bartholomew.
row.notes: The mature content boils down: - to blood smear effect on screen to indicate that the player has been damaged - the monster character in the game spurts blood when shot - the design of the monster character can be considered off putting to certain type of audiences, especially kids

row.name: Hop n' Hook
row.detailed_description: Hop n' Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection.  You play as Hoppe Jr., using a fishing rod that doubles as a grappling hook. Swing across gaps, scale cliffs, and cast into remote ponds to reel in over 50 unique fish. Some are simple. Others fight back—pulling you into short, reactive boss encounters that break the calm with bursts of tension. The world is open and layered with secrets. Optional quests and side paths reward players who take their time, while platforming challenges and precision grappling keep movement fast and satisfying. There’s no combat. No timers. Just a steady rhythm of hopping, casting, and exploring a world that quietly unfolds as you go.
row.short_description: Hop n' Hook is a platforming-fishing game set across three distinct zones, built around movement, exploration, and collection. Swing with your rod, explore open-ended zones, and catch over 100 unique fish—some of which fight back in reactive boss encounters.

row.name: Astral Lodge
row.detailed_description: Astral Lodge is a short but sweet 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of early 2000s Flash games. Explore a surreal, dreamlike environment rendered entirely with hand-drawn assets and painted backgrounds. Set across seven fixed camera views of a single strange room, Astral Lodge invites players to solve 3–4 environmental puzzles using object interactions and visual clues. Your skeletal cursor glows green over interactive elements, and a visible inventory at the bottom of the screen allows you to use items you collect directly in the scene.  There are no save states, menus, or customization options—just a linear, ambient, and slightly eerie point-and-click experience. Perfect for fans of obscure web-based games from the early internet, Astral Lodge delivers a singular mood in under 30 minutes. The game runs in a fixed 1280x960 resolution and can be exited at any time by closing the window. Story, art, music/sfx and game design by James Ryan Wallker.
row.short_description: A short 2D point-and-click room escape game in the spirit of flash games of the early internet. Explore a surreal, dreamlike room, using objects and clues to interact with the environment and escape.

row.name: NEODITRONIX
row.detailed_description: NEODITRONIX is the dreamcore rhythm experience, available as a web-based, standalone freeware title. HEAR various sounds with frenetic rhythm gameplay, utilizing unique lane lasers. RECOLLECT memories with a full narrative exploring lost dreams. KINETIC RHYTHMIC ACTION Challenge yourself with traditional rhythm arcade 4k action, flipped upside down with a unique lane-shifting mechanic. Use your mouse to move the lanes along the line while handling the 4 lanes simultaneously! The game offers 3 ( ? ) different difficulties: Lite, Neon, and Enigma, for those looking to set the adversity to their liking. A HAUNTING, DREAMY ADVENTURE Enter the dreamworld. Awake in a spaceship with no memories and a strange, mysterious companion in tow, hear Shiro 's past in 2D side-scrolling vignettes in the Adventure mode. Uncover the secrets of Shiro's past and the universe surrounding him. FEATURES A love letter to rhythm games, narrative games, and the SKY HOUR WORKS doujin circle, published as a part of our  6th anniversary! Including playable tracks from takehirotei, Tatsuoto, Kyotsugyon, DeBisco, Frums, and more! Future updates will include new story content, accessibility features, playable tracks, and secrets. creature
row.short_description: THE DREAMCORE RHYTHM EXPERIENCE

row.name: Ice Dodo
row.detailed_description: Ice Dodo is a 3D parkour game in outer space. This game is a decade old and it is finally available on Steam. With simple controls, avoid falling off the slippery ice or hitting the cones. In this game, you can press left and right to steer the player (called a dodo). Hitting up arrow will make the player jump, and hitting down arrow will make the player drift on certain parts of the map. This game has an in-game level editor. However, it is not available on Steam right now. Anyways, Ice Dodo has around 800 levels and they are all totally unlocked except at the very start of the game. The OG cup and Dodo cup contain maps made by Seojoon Yeon, the developer, with the rest having been designed by the community. If you are a fan of Roblox or Minecraft parkour, this game is absolutely for you. But what makes Ice Dodo unique is that you can not stop the forward movement of the player. Reaction time is crucial. Fun history of Ice Dodo: Seojoon Yeon created this game as a Chrome Extension back when he was 13 years old as a fun way for his classmates to play games during school lectures. Now it is available to play on the website and on Steam!
row.short_description: INSANE PARKOUR GAME IN OUTER SPACE. Using left and right arrow buttons, bring the character to the finish line. But watch out -- if you hit the cones or fall off the platform, then you must restart! All 711 maps totally unlocked!
row.reviews: “And for all you gamers out there, Ice Dodo is a fast-paced 3D platforming game that requires balance, speed and finesse.” 10 – Google

row.name: LLM×Quiz
row.detailed_description: LLM×Quiz — A New Kind of Quiz Battle Adventure with AI! Guided by his grandfather’s journal, a young boy explores a legendary ruin. The moment he discovers the treasure, a stone guardian awakens: 'Prove your knowledge!' LLM×Quiz fuses quiz and card battle into a turn-based adventure. Use your skill cards and knowledge to outsmart an AI opponent. The more accurate and meaningful your answers, the more damage you deal! ■ Quiz × Card Battle, Reinvented Answer simple quiz questions freely via text input! For example, a question like 'Name all forms of Wednesday' may accept 'Wednesday', '水曜日', 'ウェンズデー', etc. AI judges your answer and adjusts the damage accordingly. ■ Control the Match with Skill Cards Disrupt the enemy, restrict answers, and change the flow with powerful cards. Strategy is just as important as knowledge! ■ Intelligent AI Opponent The guardian is powered by AI and adapts based on difficulty. Expect smart, evolving answers as the challenge intensifies. ■ Unique Free-Form Quiz Battles No fixed choices—express your knowledge your way. Every match feels fresh and different thanks to open-ended answers. ■ Quick and Casual for All Ages Each game takes about 15 minutes. Simple quizzes and intuitive mechanics make it fun for all generations. Perfect for a quick play or repeat sessions!
row.short_description: A quiz battle adventure where AI asks and judges! Use skill cards to change the tide and defeat the stone guardian with your knowledge. Each match takes around 15 minutes—fun, casual, and great for all ages!

row.name: VTuber冒險村
row.detailed_description: Live, Grow, and Adventure with Your Favorite VTubers! VTuber Adventure Village is a multiplayer online casual adventure game that combines virtual streamer interaction with role-playing elements . Designed for both VTubers and their fans, the game seamlessly blends life simulation, resource gathering, village building, and community interaction. In this world, every village is led by a unique VTuber. They are not fictional NPCs, but real creators and streamers you already know and support—joining you in daily life, adventures, and interactions within the village. As an “Adventurer,” you will enter the dedicated server of your favorite VTuber, gather resources, contribute to village growth, and take part in building a thriving community together with other players. Through special quests and mini-games, you can create memorable interactions with the VTubers themselves. In VTuber Adventure Village : Each server is a world shaped by the unique style of its VTuber. Each journey is a story co-written with the village leader. This is a brand-new adventure that connects VTubers, players, and communities. Here, the game is not just about playing—it’s about growing, sharing, and experiencing together. Key Features Varied Activities : Mine rare resources, go fishing, and hunt wild creatures. Character Customization : Collect items to unlock outfits and create your own unique style. Expanding Content : Ongoing updates bring new challenges and more appearance options. Community Interaction : Join VTuber-led events, contribute to village development, and complete community missions. Relaxed Companion Experience : Strengthen the bond between VTubers and fans in a shared game world.
row.short_description: VtuberStory is a multiplayer casual game where you step into a VTuber’s unique world as an adventurer. Collect resources through mining, fishing, and hunting, then trade them for outfits to customize your look. Explore, build, and connect with VTubers and fellow fans in a vibrant virtual village!

row.name: Voden's Job
row.detailed_description: Voden's Job is a small roguelike deckbuilding game where you have 7 rounds of experiments to collect enough DNA to evolve your specimen. Between each experiment, you can upgrade your deck with new cards, combos, and strange tools. The catch? Upgrading costs DNA, so you'll need to carefully balance how much you're willing to spend each round. The rules are simple : each experiment round is about playing Mutation cards until you run out of options. Mutation cards have a cost, paid with Eye cards, and each one has a different effect, like drawing more cards or gaining DNA. A Mutation is too weak ? Just throw in some Enzyme cards to unleash powerful combos . Features 37 unique cards, including Mutation, Eye, and Enzyme types 5 powerful tools to amplify card effects and tilt the odds in your favor Fast-paced, streamlined gameplay Endless replayability: each round is different Atmospheric soundtrack mixed with splatter-style sound design Rich pixel art visuals with plenty of juicy effects
row.short_description: Play cards that draw cards, that draw more cards, that earn you DNA to evolve your specimen.

Ships and monsters will attack you, and you must defeat them in order to advance using your different skills and leveling up to advance through dioramas in a moving galaxy and become stronger, with the final goal being to end the threat that inhabits the center of the galaxy. Save the galaxy: Throughout your adventure, you can decide whether or not to help defend the different planets, which are under heavy attack by numerous waves of enemies, thus getting large amounts of experience to level up. Are you up to the challenge?

row.name: Calm the Storm
row.detailed_description: Theo and Kallie are on their way out for a fun night at the club. Little do they know that monsters lurk in the shadows...  waiting for a patsy, a snack, or maybe a saviour. The night will tell. Calm the Storm is a branching game that combines the experience of a narrative podcast with the interactive decision-making of a choose-your-own-path story or visual novel, letting the listener choose their preferred outcome for the story. Will Theo unlock hidden powers? Will Kallie take arms and fight a vampire? Only you can decide. Ludic Lemur is excited to release this narrative experiment to audiences for free. And it is an experiment. We're pretty sure this hands-free, voice-controllable adventure is the first game of its kind, intended to be accessible for people who are visually impaired, with closed captioning for people who are Deaf and/or hard of hearing and a voice-command interface for people with manual and/or visual impairments.  Since launching, we have collected feedback from Playability, AccessAbility, and a core group of players. We've updated the prototype with accessibility adjustments, including the ability to pause, skip forward, and some graphic updates. We are hard at work on a new, full-length game that will pick up where Calm the Storm left off. Follow this game in order to get updates about that companion game. *Please note, Calm the Storm contains mild profanity and low-gore violence.
row.short_description: A free narrative experiment in accessible gaming.

row.detailed_description: Delfini is a gentle and delicate two-player cooperative ocean exploration game, it is about a moving journey where two dolphins bravely save the polluted coral reef island. In this clear ocean world, players will accompany two dolphins as they rescue their fellow sea creature friends, who are trapped by harmful substances, to encounter a story of friendship, hope, and healing. You and your friend will guide these two dolphins to clean up the polluted coral reefs, which is not only about preserving the marine environment but also about building friendships and maintaining protection. During your exploration, the rescued sea creature friends will join your team to support and help you protect the coral world under the sea. The soothing music, combined with the relaxing gameplay, will bring a calming and healing feeling to players, making Delfini a game where you can unwind with friends and soothe your soul from busy life routines. Here in Delfini, every action is meaningful, and every coral reef cleanup represents a new hope for the sea. Whether you are playing the game to protect the environment, for appreciation, or to feel touched by Delfini's poetic story, you will always find your own rhythm under the sea.

row.name: 幻兽大农场：放置好时光 Playtest
Fading Lights
row.detailed_description: Step into the fading memories of Max, an elderly man living with dementia. This narrative-driven first-person detective game invites you to explore Max’s home, uncover forgotten fragments of his past, and slowly piece together his family tree while experiencing the world through his perspective. You play as Max, wandering through his house filled with everyday objects that spark vivid but fragile memories. Each object leads to an interactive scene from Max’s daily life but also some defining moments, while also revealing the symptoms of dementia. Between memories, you’ll piece together the family tree, connecting names and relationships using the clues you’ve gathered. A unique feature of the game is its dual art style, designed to emphasize the contrast between reality and memory. Max’s present-day home is depicted in a realistic and darker style, grounding the player in the weight of his current life. In contrast, his memories unfold in a cutesy, surreal aesthetic, filled with bright colors and softened shapes. This shift highlights that these scenes are not reality, but fragile, idealized fragments of the past, beautiful, yet fleeting. The game features an emotional soundtrack designed to complement the fragile, dreamlike atmosphere of Max’s memories, with subtle audio cues that guide the player and intensify the emotional impact of key moments. Gameplay Features • Exploration & Discovery: Search Max’s home for objects that unlock memory sequences. • Memory Diving: Enter Max’s fading recollections, where you gather clues and experience his life events from his perspective. • Symptom-Based Challenges: Each memory reflects a different symptom of dementia, from disorientation to false memories, creating unique gameplay twists. • Family Tree Reconstruction: Use the clues you uncover to rebuild Max’s family tree. After each memory, connect names and relationships in the UI to gradually restore his history. • Dialog Review System: Revisit conversations and hints in the UI to ensure you never miss a crucial detail. Unlike traditional puzzle or detective games, this experience blends storytelling with psychological authenticity. By tying each gameplay sequence to a symptom of dementia, players don’t just uncover Max’s story, they feel what it’s like to live with his condition. The result is a deeply empathetic, emotional journey about memory, identity, and family.
row.short_description: A first person detective game inspired by return of obra dinn where you have to interact with various items inside a house and unlock old memories to rebuild your Family Tree.
row.notes: Dementia is the first and most important part about our game which can be unsettling for some people.

row.name: Narrow One
row.detailed_description: This game is all about capturing flags. Fight your way into enemy territory and steal their flag. Use hidden paths and clever routes to sneak past enemy defenses. Once you’ve got the flag, you’ll be target number one. Team up with friends, cover each other, and battle your way to victory. Fast-paced 5v5 action built for skillful play. Jump into quick, intense matches with friends or solo. Choose from 6 distinct classes, each with its own team role, like the speedy Runner for flag captures or the Support class for covering teammates from afar. Find your playstyle, own your role, and lead your team to victory. Easy to learn, tough to master — that’s where the real challenge and fun begins. There’s tons of gear to unlock. Earn coins by playing rounds and explore the shop for outfits, weapons, bow skins, arrows, tattoos, and more. Mix and match to create your own unique look, and now it’s time to flex on the battlefield. There are 17+ unique maps to explore, each with its own vibe and secrets. From Samurai castles and desert oases to Viking forts and Greek sky temples, every map has their own theme. Alternate map versions will force you to adapt your routes. Plus, changing weather every round means you’ll need to stay sharp. Features: 5v5 online multiplayer flag capture 6 different bows with customisable skins 50+ different melee weapons Customizable characters and gear Squad up with friends Controller, touchscreen & gamepad support Seasonal content 17+ unique maps Regular new content Weekly gamemodes
row.short_description: Join fast-paced archery battles where you and your teammates fight to capture the enemy flag medieval style. Master your bow, and outplay the enemy in tactical 5v5 matches

row.name: Scratch Inc.
row.detailed_description: Build an Empire, From Scratch Scratch cards, earn points, and grow your empire in this idle/incremental game. Upgrade your cards, unlock automation, prestige across industries, and climb the leaderboards. Endless Upgrades – Boost your point gain, match multipliers, grid size, and so much more. Prestige for Progress – Reset to climb faster across deep progression layers. Achievements with Rewards – Earn Gold and multipliers by completing fun challenges. Global Leaderboards – Compete with others across the world across a variety of challenges. Playable Offline – Play anywhere anytime No Ads. No Wait Timers. Just Progress and Big Numbers.
row.short_description: Build an Empire, From Scratch, in this Scratch Card Idle/Incremental game.

row.name: Robot & Froggy
row.detailed_description: Robot & Froggy is an adventure for friendship. Explore the inner depths of the forest and climb to the top to solve a monumental task: Save the forest from THE MACHINE. A world of physics The game features an advanced physics simulation where dynamic objects and characters interact and affect each other (exploding, combining, colliding) through the use of props, or even better: holding, grabbing, pulling, pushing, all with the power of... hands! And a sticky tongue. Use your abilities to jump at the right moment, throw your friend up or grab them before they fall, or even use dynamite to propel yourself. The path is yours to conquer. Imagined for coop Robot and Froggy aren't just two characters—they're two halves of a solution, life accompanying life. Froggy is beefy, light and versatile, Robot is precise and robust. Some obstacles demand everything from both: Froggy holds something with Robot, they use a rope, a box, they combine: making something far too heavy or far become light and close. It's a combination of trust, tension, and teamwork. Choose who will be the Robot and who will be Froggy, climb and play together. Can be played solo, but dreamt for two. Emotion Ever thought climbing a mountain is hard? It is. Defeating THE MACHINE? Even harder. But remember: A dream dreamt alone is but a fleeting shadow of the mind. Yet a dream dreamt together weaves itself into reality.
row.short_description: Robot & Froggy is a heartfelt physics based co-op adventure about friendship and courage. Journey through mysterious forests and climb the greatest heights to stop THE MACHINE from consuming all habitat. Choose Robot or Froggy, combine your skills or alone, and climb the mountain!

row.name: God Fishing
row.detailed_description: Overview God Fishing is an experimental idle fishing game with aspects of horror and a running narrative. You solve puzzles to find the right combinations of location and bait to find certain catches. After throwing your hook, you will have to wait for a varying amount of time. Catching a fish will reveal some dialogue which will help you understand the wider narrative. Features part 1 7 different fish to catch A minimalist pixel art style A wide narrative A small crafting system Vibes part 2 Will be released somewhere in the future as a free update to the current game
row.short_description: Once, there was a fisherman who preferred the quiet waves. On one night, the waves were not so quiet. For on this night, the fish would talk. In this idle experience, solve puzzles and wait in anticipation for your catch to be caught. Solve the mystery of the odd fish society and the god they serve.

row.name: Laser Harp VR
row.detailed_description: Become the Stealth Major. Take center stage and play the laser harp in a VR rhythm game that transforms performance into pure expression. This is not just about hitting notes—this is about becoming the music. Featuring a collection of original tracks across various genres, this immersive VR experience invites players to step into a dynamic concert space where light and sound respond to your every move. Key Features Immersive Live-Style VR Stage ： Experience music-reactive lighting and visual effects that shift with every beat. Laser Harp Interaction ： Use your hands to perform with a virtual laser harp—intuitive, engaging, and expressive. Easy to Learn, Expressive to Master ： Designed with accessibility in mind, focusing on musical expression over technical difficulty. Original Music Across Genres  ：Tracks range from 1 to 5 minutes, offering a wide variety of moods and styles to explore. Score if you like—but the true reward is expressing the music in your own unique way. *The Early Access version is currently experiencing compatibility issues with the HTC Vive headset and may not work properly. A fix is planned for the production version.
row.short_description: You too can be a stealth major You will be the organizer and make the live show a success!　Please note that the instrument to be handled is the “Laser Harp”.

row.name: Underfishing
row.detailed_description: Fishing! Dialogue! Upgrades! The unbearable weight of a lifetime's worth of regrets! Enjoy a bite-sized narrative fishing experience! Fish out a variety of ancient treasures, make small talk with your local low-level demon companion, and attempt to come to terms with the fact your will never get back all the time you wasted, or reconcile all the bad choices you made in life. That is, of course, unless you can fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life. Many have tried for thousands of years, but you will be the one to finally do it, right? Featuring: Fun dialogue with your assigned demon   A variety of fishing upgrades Tons of ancient treasures to fish out Enjoy your afterlife! Trust me, it gets better after the first few centuries. Attributions: Zombie icons created by Freepik on FlatIcon , Sea icons created by Khoirul Huda on FlatIcon : Stylized Old Fishing Rod Low Poly by alexi.smnd on Sketchfab Fish hook icons created by Ehtisham Abid on FlatIcon :
row.short_description: You just arrived in hell. Nothing left to to do but contemplate the life you lived, and fish. Fish out ancient treasures, upgrade your fishing abilities, and face your biggest regrets in this narrative fishing game! Will you manage to fish out Lucifer's crown and earn another chance at life?

row.name: taking my Dark Knight Girlfriend to the corner store
row.detailed_description: Dana is a mostly normal girl living a mostly normal life until one day, Brunhilde- a fearsome Dark Knight from another realm- tears through a portal in the sky and asks Dana to guide her to find and slay the mysterious Gray Wizard. Instantly, Dana enlists herself as Brunhilde's companion and guide, promising to help her find her prize in this unfamiliar world - all while praying Brunhilde never catches onto the fact that Dana has no idea who she's looking for. In 'Taking My Dark Knight Girlfriend to the Corner Store,' accompany Dana as she takes her girlfriend out on a grocery trip and live a day in the life of a woman living with a Dark Knight. Experience the thrill of picking out snacks for a servant of Evil, argue that winning a claw machine is essential to her quest, and don't let her kill anyone! About 10k words and 1 hour of gameplay One true ending (and one silly ending) with fun choices along the way Cute, hand-drawn artwork with full CGs Lesbian t4t romance Tuss
row.short_description: A beautiful Dark Knightess from another world enlisted me in her quest to slay a rogue wizard, and now we're dating! But what if she finds out I have no idea who the Gray Wizard is?!

row.name: Bad Golf
row.detailed_description: Bad Golf is a casual but competitive multiplayer 2D golf game. Play local multiplayer or online with friends for lowest score or fastest time. Originally published for the Xbox Live Indie Games platform, it became an indie darling receiving international acclaim. Actual internet comments: 'The game is the most fun with more than one player ... as players do not take 'turns', everyone just fires away until they make it at the same time.' 'Bad Golf on XBLIG is great and the cause of plenty of shouting at the TV at my place.' 'Bad Golf is actually pretty good.'
row.short_description: Don't let the name fool you! A former Xbox Live Indie Games hidden gem, Bad Golf is a casual yet competitive multiplayer 2D golf game. Play a relaxing round by yourself or a frantic golf race with local or online friends.

row.name: Paper Pusher
row.detailed_description: (This game is about 1 hour long and must be completed in one sitting) Become a family member of Extricate Inc. We are the most ethical non-consensual euthanasia service available in the US government. As a Paper Pusher, you will be the one who decides who gets extinguished and who gets extricated. These choices will be made based on metrics like age, gender, job, income, physical abnormalities, drug use, and much more! This job also comes with a complimentary apartment for the time of your contract and an Extricate Home Entertainment System for you to enjoy during your downtime! Main Workload As an Extricate Inc. Paper Pusher, you will be filling papers. Each paper will be associated with a person, including details about their name, age, gender, job, and other relevant information. You then will make a decision of if that person is Extricated (Saved) or Extinguished (Killed). Each day will have 5 papers. Only two people can be Extricated per day. (This game learns who you are and what you care about in a person as you play.)
row.short_description: A short atmospheric psychological horror game. Locked in a corporate contract, you must decide who lives and who dies based only on details that can be written down about them. How will you justify your choices?
row.notes: While filling paperwork, there are mentions of drug use, both legal and not. There are mentions of prostitution. There are mentions of suicide or voluntary death. There are implications of child death.

row.name: Ice Cream Typer
row.detailed_description: Ice Cream Typer  is a high-speed typing challenge where the only way forward is faster fingers. Inspired by the infamous fitness test and arcade classics, this mode throws you into an endless typing gauntlet. Complete ridiculous words and phrases under pressure—each round gives you less time, and one slip-up could be the end. It’s goofy, intense, and surprisingly addictive. How It Works: A phrase appears on screen. You type it. Quickly and correctly. The next round starts… with even less time. Repeat until you break—or beat your high score. Key Features: Pacer Test Mode with Increasing Difficulty: The timer gets shorter every round. Stay sharp or get dropped. Speed & Accuracy-Based Scoring: Points and combos scale with how fast (and clean) you type. Goofy Word Prompts:  The cat did what? Cheerful, Upbeat Vibes: Lighthearted music and satisfying sound effects keep the energy high. Simple & Focused: Just your keyboard, a timer, and a screen full of sweetness.
row.short_description: A fast-paced typing arcade game where each round gives you less time to type bizarre phrases. Test your speed, accuracy, and endurance in an endless challenge that gets harder every step

row.name: Bound Between Desks
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a school where nothing is quite what it seems. Bound Between Desks is a story-driven visual novel set in an ordinary school that's hiding something. Beneath the surface of regular classes and casual conversations, there's a darker mystery waiting to be uncovered. The choices you make will determine not only how the story unfolds, but what truths you'll discover along the way. Key Features Complex Characters Build relationships, earn trust, or watch it crumble as you dig deeper into their secrets. How you interact with each character directly affects where the story goes. An Unsettling Setting The school looks normal enough at first glance. But as you explore its classrooms, hallways, and forgotten corners, the boundary between reality and something stranger starts to blur. How far are you willing to go for answers? Meaningful Choices Your decisions matter. With over four different endings and multiple variations, no two playthroughs are the same. Each choice you make reveals a different piece of the puzzle. Striking Anime-Style Visuals The game features expressive character art and carefully composed scenes that pull you into the school's tense, mysterious atmosphere. Immersive Soundtrack Experience deeper immersion through a soundtrack that highlights every moment of tension, mystery, and revelation. The music amplifies each emotion and enhances the atmosphere of every scene. What Awaits You Cross-Platform Gaming : Play on Windows, macOS, Linux Rich Storyline : 5+ chapters of gripping narrative with updates. Multiple Endings : Discover all secrets through various story paths Full Localization : Complete support for Russian and English languages(will add other after release) Genre and Atmosphere This is a mystery visual novel with psychological elements and touches of horror. The school starts off feeling safe and familiar, but that sense of normalcy won't last. You'll question what's real, who you can trust, and what's lurking just out of sight. If you like visual novels with strong writing, impactful choices, and tension that sticks with you after you've closed the game, this one's for you. Discover the truth. Make your choices. Decide who—and what—matters most.
row.short_description: A mystical visual novel where ordinary school life intertwines with mysterious phenomena. Every decision you make could lead to uncovering secrets... or plunge you into even greater uncertainty.
row.notes: This game contains dark and emotionally intense themes, including psychological horror and disturbing atmosphere. While no explicit content is present, certain scenes may be unsettling or uncomfortable for sensitive players.

row.name: SCP: Yet Another Day
row.detailed_description: ACT 1 RELEASED! future acts   soon The SCP foundation was once a prestigious organization dedicated to maintaining order in the world and containing supernatural anomalies however today, the SCP facility has fallen into madness with it's management dominated by brain rotted morons and it's power worsening day by day.... not only allowing the dangers contained within to break out but also a certain bloodthirsty intruder to infiltrate in, only a matter of time before all hell breaks loose in the fever dream chaos of the story. The brain rotted morons that reside down in the facility each have a quirk uniquely wrong with them (from the schizophrenic addict lars, a d class inmate of the facility to our protagonist cat girl sinner, the reincarnation of the demon the scarlet king) as they all play a role within the group dynamic whilst also having their own concealed arcs and ambitions under the surface... not all of these arcs will be completed however as no one is safe from the narratives brutality so not all will survive... SCP: Yet Another Day's combat uses a hybrid gameplay system between a dynamic RPG and a turn based card game, blend card combinations together to create absurd decks that exploit the games mechanics to clear your enemies, culminating in deadly bosses that put your skills to the challenge and demand calculated adapting to win. AN EXPANSIVE LORE - The history of the foundation stretches across time and beyond with several secrets behind the scenes to be put together presenting a layered mystery. UNIQUE PLAYTHROUGHS - Depending on what traits are chosen by the player the dialogue they experience will be specialized to them allowing them to discover information others do not. THE CHAOS INSURGENCY HAS HIJACKED THIS DESCRIPTION - Do not be fooled by the foundation, they are corrupt and not what they seem... this must be stopped, that is why we at the chaos insurgency, the greatest faction in the verse are calling YOU to join the rebellion and FIGHT BACK! PLAY ACT 1 NOW!!!
row.short_description: SCP: Yet Another Day is a mess of genres RPG where a dysfunctional friend group must get it together to escape a monster filled facility and survive a psychopathic terrorist, expect madness
row.notes: the game contains consistent strong language, description of extreme violence and mature themes including drugs, suicide and mental health

row.name: Panzer Kliker
row.detailed_description: 🔧 Build the tank of your dreams — one click at a time! In Panzer Klicker Mk I , you take on the role of engineer, commander, and clicker-in-chief. Your mission: construct the ultimate armored beast by collecting parts, assembling a crew. 🪖 Gameplay: Earn points by clicking tank. Spend your resources on tank parts (tracks, guns, armor) and recruit your elite crew – from commander to loader and two gunners. Every upgrade boosts your clicking efficiency! 🌄 Retro style, modern destruction Classic pixel-art visuals Simple interface – parts on the left, crew on the right, YOUR TANK in the center Score and rank system – climb to the general! Unlock hidden upgrades and experimental tech! Will your machine dominate the battlefield or end up a pile of scrap? One click can make the difference... 🛠 Panzer Klicker Mk I – Click & build!
row.short_description: Idle tank-building clicker game with retro pixel-art style. Assemble parts, recruit crew, and upgrade your war machine to climb the ranks - even while you're away!

row.name: 원 샷(One Shot)
row.detailed_description: One Shot is a top-down shooter set in the Wild West. A former sheriff, enraged after his son is kidnapped, heads into the outlaw’s den for revenge. Gear up with a variety of weapons and prepare for one-shot kills. A single mistake means death. One-Shot, One-Kill Gunfights Every enemy dies in a single shot — but so do you. Equip revolvers, bullets, focused shots, and trinkets to craft your unique loadout. There’s no need to unlock gear. Experiment with all kinds of builds. No Cover, No Tricks All enemies are ready to shoot at you. At least they’re only using guns. There are no walls to hide behind — but luckily, your bullets won’t get stuck either.
row.short_description: One Shot is a top-down shooting game set in the Wild West. A former sheriff, burning with vengeance after his son is kidnapped, heads into an outlaw hideout to wipe them out. Arm yourself well and prepare for one-shot kills.
row.notes: This game contains realistic gunfights, graphic violence, and a dark, oppressive atmosphere. It does not contain sexual content, drug use, self-harm, or depictions of sexual violence.

row.name: The Asterion
row.detailed_description: 🧵 Enter the Labyrinth Asterion is a rogue-like action-adventure set in the mythological Labyrinth of Knossos. Play as Theseus , guided by Ariadne , and explore a shifting maze full of traps, spirits, and forgotten secrets. ⚔️ Features 🧠 Environmental puzzles inspired by Daedalus’ inventions 🧵 Procedurally generated labyrinth floors 👻 Enemies from Greek myth: shades, animated statues... 🧪 Mythical artifacts: Ares' Rage, Eolus' Claw, Icarus' Wings... 🗣️ Atmospheric storytelling through voice lines and cutscenes 🎨 A unique visual style inspired by ancient frescoes and modern indie games 🎯 A Game of Choice and Consequence You’re not just fighting the Minotaur — you’re fighting your fate. Each run uncovers new fragments of the myth, as you piece together your destiny.
row.short_description: Asterion is a stylized rogue-like adventure inspired by Greek mythology. Explore the Labyrinth, face the Minotaur, and uncover a haunting story of gods, betrayal, and survival.

row.name: DepthLess
row.detailed_description: DepthLess does not follow a traditional story. Instead, it delivers a deeply atmospheric experience — a descent through surreal, decaying environments filled with disturbingly unnatural creatures and oppressive silence. There are no dialogues, cutscenes, or exposition. Every step forward leads you deeper into environments that become increasingly abstract, corrupted, and hostile. The real narrative is your journey downward — facing the unknown, solving subtle spatial puzzles, and surviving a world that clearly wasn't made for humans. There is no traditional story in DepthLess. Instead, the experience itself is the story — a wordless descent through isolated architecture, shifting environments, and your own perception. With every fall, the world becomes more distorted. There is no narrator, no cutscene. Only space, sound, and your decisions. **rapidly press R and Spacebar** to move forward. It might feel tricky at first, but once you get used to it, it becomes much easier!
row.short_description: A surreal first-person platformer horror game where you descend into nightmarish architecture, solve spatial puzzles, and survive grotesque creatures.

row.name: Lloyd the Monkey: Remastered
row.detailed_description: The first installment of the Lloyd the Monkey trilogy has arrived on Steam in a remastered form, rebuilt from the ground up to create the ideal version of the classic platformer! Centuries have passed since the new millennium, and not only has humanity taken to the stars, but our closest relatives have evolved to match us and have created a society all their own in the Amazon jungle, a paradise where nature and technology blend in harmony. But destiny dictates that life never stays the same for very long, as a mysterious, bushy-tailed girl has fallen from the sky and, with nowhere else to go, has taken up residence with the Zaru brothers Lloyd and Arnie. Unbeknownst to all, this girl’s presence has attracted the attention of a seedy group of gorillas who have claimed land still poisoned by the sins of the past as their base. For there is a secret hidden from all parties that will soon change the lives of everyone who gets tangled up in it. The Lloyd the Monkey saga is about to begin! Features: All twelve stages from the HMTL5 version, combined into six maps. Classical music complementing the original score. Retro aesthetics invoking the 16-bit classics. Polygonal 3D Special Stages.
row.short_description: A mysterious girl falls from the sky and sets simian swordsman Lloyd Zaru on an adventure that will change his world forever!

row.name: 无限刀传奇
row.detailed_description: Players will play as a warrior with unique skills, using automatic attacks to carve a path through levels filled with monsters. During 闯关 (level progression), players face a constant onslaught of monsters. As levels advance, the difficulty increases gradually, with the number and strength of monsters 不断 (continuously) rising. Players can collect coins and diamonds by defeating monsters. Coins can be used in the in-game store to upgrade various powerful attributes, while diamonds unlock advanced warrior skills, enable summoning of powerful pets, and allow purchasing other hero characters. The game includes a sign-in system, offering rich rewards. There is also a dungeon system, where playing dungeons yields more rewards to enhance player strength, as well as a mission system and a lucky draw system, ensuring an engaging player experience.
row.short_description: This is a fantasy level-based game. During the level-clearing process, players can obtain gold coins and diamond rewards, which can be used to enhance the character's strength and purchase different characters The game also includes a check-in system, a roulette lottery system, and a mission system

row.name: Justice Became Prey
row.detailed_description: You wake up and everything is in its place — your family, your home, your hopes, and your peace. Then, someone who has lost their humanity — and with it, all their values — comes and rips away your happiness. You have two choices: Give up and accept your helplessness? Or fight for your life and your hopes? Key Features: 🎯 Story-Driven FPS Gameplay : A blend of action and narrative. 🎭 Emotional Narrative : Themes of justice, regret, inner journey, and personal reckoning. 🧠 Stealth or Action : Dive headfirst into the action or take the silent path through stealth gameplay. 🎧 Sound & Music : Music that enhances and supports the storytelling experience. Explosives, knives, guns, bullets, endless sand, pain, destruction, and corrupted souls... But this game focuses more on emotions than weapons, on silence more than explosions, and on inner reckoning rather than rage. If you're looking for a meaningful first-person shooter experience with a powerful story, this journey is made for you.
row.short_description: Ali, who lives an ordinary life, loses all the happiness and peace he once had in a single day. And with a glimmer of hope, he begins searching for the peace he can no longer find in this world — for himself and his little sister.

row.name: Peach Tangle
row.detailed_description: A boy and a girl,  and a story about defeating loneliness in a mysterious forest. Peach Tangle is a visual novel with fully animated scenes, including all the sex scenes! Get to know a cute girl with a unique personality and explore a beautifully rendered forest full of secrets, in this short, gripping story! A story full of drama, comedy and mystery. Characters Wendel A loner, half by choice, half by necessity.  Fundamentally a good guy, he's very pleasant if you take the effort to get to know him. The problem is he rarely makes that effort himself, and other people don't really have a reason to either. So all his life he's had very few close friends and even fewer girls. Mira A strong-willed girl. She doesn't see it herself, but people often call her a tomboy. She's always looking out for other people, even if it means a bunch of extra work for herself. Despite hardships, she does her best to stay cheerful. Features: 2-4 Hours of reading time. HD 1080P - Enjoy the game with HD graphics and illustrations. Animated sex scenes. 14+ fantastic music tracks. Everything crafted lovingly by human hands, no AI. 3D characters & BGs mixed with 2D hand painted artworks. If you like the game hit me up on Patreon to help me make more games! (AhaNubis @ Patreon)
row.short_description: A boy and a girl, and a story about defeating loneliness in a mysterious forest. A short and heartwarming romance visual novel where you get to know the cute tomboy Mira! Animated sexual scenes, great music and award-winning art!
row.notes: Contains depictions of consensual sexual acts.

row.name: Catanks
row.detailed_description: Blast your way through feline fun with Catanks! Follow an immersive level-styled campaign with unique rodent enemies and homely yet hazardous environments, or battle nonstop against explosive combatants in riveting classic missions. Catanks is a 3D game created by students from UPGRADE, reimagining nostalgic tank combat with decisive third-person cat-piloted gameplay. Features: Campaign: Defend your home from the invading rats in exciting 3rd person tank gameplay in Catanks's campaign! Each level introduces new mechanics and challenges, such as navigating around sharp obstacles or fending off heavy artillery. Classic Mode: Test your skills against 50 consecutive top-down arcade-style levels with the objective to kill all enemies in each level. Each level becomes more difficult than the last and raises the stakes. Special Abilities: Use two special Catank abilities to help blast your way through levels. Rocket Cat is for those who want more firepower while Bubble Cat allows you to slip by enemies without taking damage. Achievements: Unlock Steam achievements by completing feats of skill such as beating the game in an unconventional way!
row.short_description: Catanks is a 3D game created by students from UPGRADE, reimagining nostalgic tank combat with decisive third-person cat-piloted gameplay.

row.name: 重生之我亲爱的妹妹复仇计划
row.detailed_description: 游戏简介 “哥哥，我最讨厌你了。” 一觉醒来，你重生回了几个月前——那个你亲妹妹还活着，继妹和义妹还没彻底毁掉你人生的时间点。 上辈子的你太天真，被两位“妹妹”玩弄于股掌之中：财产被卷走、父亲被关进精神病院、最爱的亲妹妹死于车祸，最后你跳河自尽——完美结局。 这一次？你有了外挂—— 亲爱的妹妹System ！ 在这个系统中，只要和真正的妹妹相处，就能积攒“妹驱力”，解锁各种荒诞离谱的技能与道具。从“读档存档”到“妹妹侦探技能”，再到“斗地主必胜牌技”，甚至可以发动“欧尼酱之惊叹”——一切只为拯救妹妹，拯救家庭，完成一场甜蜜又惊心动魄的复仇！ 角色介绍
row.short_description: 在前世被“妹妹们”毁掉一切的你，重生回到悲剧发生前。面对撒娇、腹黑、洗脑甚至怨念成魔的“妹妹大军”，你必须斗智斗勇，守护家庭，上演一场荒诞爆笑的兄妹逆转剧。
row.notes: This game includes some depictions of violence, suicide, and murder scenes, all presented in a lighthearted and humorous context. These elements are integral to the satirical storyline and are not depicted in a realistic or graphic manner, and the game does not aim to shock or disturb.

row.name: INFLAMED
row.detailed_description: UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage. INFLAMED is the winner of the Georgia Game Developer Association's 2024 'Best in Georgia' competition. Initially developed during the 48-hour Global Game Jam, Inflamed underwent an additional month of development to produce the BiG Submission downloadable demo, which is now on Steam for the world to play! CONTROLLER RECOMMENDED! Left Stick to Move Right Stick to Flail Around Either Trigger to Pick Up and Release Left and Right Bumpers to Cycle Character Select Right Special Button to Connect Controllers and Select Character Left Special Button to Pause Inflamed features a campaign where its Inflatable protagonists advance through a series of protests. Each protest takes place at a unique location relevant to the plight of the unpaid Inflatables. In order to make a change and rally support, players will need to earn a series of symbolic victories, hurting bottom lines and garnering positive sentiment for the Inflatable revolution. These symbolic victories take the form of objectives for players to complete at each protest - often requiring them to cause wacky and destructive mayhem. Players will need to work together to effectively complete their objectives and claim victory!
row.short_description: NO INFLATION WITHOUT REPRESENTATION! UNITE and fight for the rights of wacky Inflatables everywhere by causing destructive mayhem through a campaign of protests staged across the nation. Flop and Flail together in a memorable righteous rampage.
